a: Mishna kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman – kesherot, ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova, chutz mimminchat chote uminchat kenaot.
Minchat chote uminchat kenaot shekkematzan shello lishman, natan bichli vehalach vehiktir shello lishman, o lishman veshello lishman, o shello lishman velishman – pesulot.
Ketzad lishman veshello lishman – leshem minchat chote uleshem minchat nedava. shello lishman velishman – leshem minchat nedava uleshem minchat chote.
Gemara lema li lemitna "ella"? litne: velo alu labbealim leshem chova!
Ha ka mashma lan: labbealim hu delo alu leshum chova, ha mincha gufa keshera, veasur leshannoye, kidrava, deamar rava: ola sheshshechatah shello lishmah – asur lizrok damah shello lishmah.
Ibbaet ema sevara, veibbaet ema kera. ibbaet ema sevara: mishshum dimshanne ba, kol hane lishanne bah venezil?

Veibbaet ema kera, "motza sefatecha tishmor veasita kaasher nadarta laAdonai elohecha nedava", nedava? neder hu! kare leh neder vekare leh nedava! ella, im kema shennadarta asita – yehe neder, veim lav – yehe nedava.
b: Unedava mi shere leshannoye ba?
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi shimon, detanya: rabbi shimon omer: kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman kesherot, vealu labbealim leshem chova.
Sheen hammenachot domot lizvachim, shehakkometz machavat leshum marcheshet – maaseha mochichin aleha leshum machavat, chareva leshum belula – maaseha mochichin aleha leshum chareva.
Aval bizvachim eno chen, shechita achat lechullan, uzerika achat lechullan, vekabbala achat lechullan.
Hanicha lerav ashe, deamar: kan bekometz machavat leshum marcheshet, kan bekometz minchat machavat leshum minchat marcheshet –
Matnitin mincha leshum mincha hi. ella lerabba verava may ikka lememar?
Vechi tema, kidka meshanne rabba: kan beshinnuy kodesh, kan beshinnuy bealim –
Ha matnitin shinnuy kodesh hu, dekatane: "ketzad lishman veshello lishman" – leshum minchat chote uleshum minchat nedava.
Vei name kidka meshanne rava: kan bekometz mincha leshum mincha, kan bekometz mincha leshum zevach –
Ha matnitin mincha leshum mincha hi, dekatane: "shello lishman velishman" – leshem minchat nedava leshem minchat chote. ella lerabba verava mechavvavrta matnitin dela kerabbi shimon.
Verame derabbi shimon adderabbi shimon, detanya: rabbi shimon omer: "kodesh kadashim hi kechattat ucheasham" – yesh mehen kechattat, veyesh mehen keasham.
Minchat chote hare hi kechattat, lefichach kematzah shello lishmah – pesula, kachattat; minchat nedava hare hi keasham, lefichach kematzah shello lishmah – keshera.
Ucheasham – ma asham kasher veeno meratztze, af minchat nedava keshera veenah meratztza.
Amar rabba, la kashya: kan beshinnuy kodesh, kan beshinnuy bealim.
Amar leh abbaye: mikkede machshava difsal rachamana hekkesha hi, ma li shinnuy kodesh, ma li shinnuy bealim?
Amar leh: maaseha mochichin dekaamar rabbi shimon, sevara hi, derabbi shimon daresh tama dikra.
Machshava dela minnachra – pesal rachamana, machshava deminnachra – la pesal rachamana.
(Siman: ola, ola, malak umitztza, chattat haof, kodshe kadashim, kadashim kallim.)
Ella meatta, olat haof shemmelakah lemala mishshum chattat haof, teratztze? maaseha mochichin aleha deolat haof hi, dei chattat haof hi – lematta have aved la.
Attu chattat haof lemala mi leta? haamar mar: melika bechol makom bammizbeach keshera!
Olat haof shemmitztza damah lemala leshem chattat haof teratztze, maaseha mochichin aleha deolat haof hi, dei chattat haof hi – lematta hava aved la hazzaa.

a: Amri: dilma mitztzuy devatar hazzaa hu, deamar mar: mitztza damah bechol makom bammizbeach keshera.
Chattat haof shehizza damah lematta leshem olat haof teratztze, demaaseha mochichin aleha dechattat of hi, dei olat haof hi – lemala hava aved la, umitztzuy hava aved lay!
Hachi name, ella lefi sheen hammenachot domot lazzevachim kaamar – lazzevachim, velo laofot.
Kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan batztzafon leshem kadashim kallim, liratztzo, maasehen mochichin alehen dekodshe kadashim ninhu, dei kadashim kallim – baddarom hava aved lehu.
Emor deamar rachamana af baddarom, baddarom velo batztzafon mi amar? ditnan: shechitatan bechol makom baazara.
Kadashim kallim sheshshechatan baddarom leshem kodshe kadashim liratztzo, maasehen mochichin alehen, dekadashim kallim ninhu, dei kodshe kadashim – batztzafon hava aved lehu.
Amri: kodshe kadashim ninhu, umibar hu daavar, ushechat lehu baddarom.
I hachi, machavat leshem marcheshet name, hay deka kametz le lemarcheshet, amar: hay bemarcheshet nedar, veha demayyte la bemachavat – demarcheshet hi, umibar hu daavar veatyay bemachavat!
Hatam, ki name bemarcheshet nadar, ki mayyte la bemachavat – machavat havya.
Keditnan: haomer "hare alay bemachavat" vehevi bemarcheshet, "bemarcheshet" vehevi bemachavat – ma shehevi hevi, vide nidro lo yatza.
Vedilma amar "zo lehavi bemachavat" vehevi bemarcheshet, keditnan: zo lehavi bemachavat vehevi bemarcheshet, bemarcheshet vehevi bemachavat – hare zo pesula.
Lerabbanan hachi name, lerabbi shimon, kevan deamar rabbi shimon: "af yede nidro yatza", alma keviuta demana vela kelum hu, vela shena amar "zo", vela shena amar "alay".
Ella meatta, ola sheshshachat leshem chattat teratztze, dehay zachar vehay nekeva, kevan deikka seir nasi dezachar hu – la yedia.
Amar: "leshem chattat yachid", may ikka lememar? vetu, chattat yachid sheshshechatah leshem ola teratztze, dechattat nekeva veola zachar? mikkasseya bealya.
Hatinach hecha deayyti kivsa, ayyti seira, may ikka lememar? ella, ben zecharim linkevot lav addatayyhu deinashe.
Pesach sheshshechato leshem asham liratztze, dehay ben shana, vehay ben shetayim, kevan deikka asham nazir vaasham metzora, la pesika leh.
Amar: "leshum asham gezelot uleshum asham meilot", may ikka lememar? vetu, asham gezelot vaasham meilot sheshshechatan leshum pesach liratztzo, defesach ben shana vehane ben shete shanim!
Ella, ben ben shana leven ben shete shanim lav addatayyhu deinashe, deikka ben shana demichaze keven shetayim, veikka ben shetayim demichaze keven shana.
Sair sheshshechato leshum asham liratztze, dehay tzemer vehay sear, amri: dichra ukkama hu.
Egel ufar sheshshechatan leshum pesach veasham, liratztzo, deegel ufar befesach veasham lekka! in hachi name,
b: Umay zevachim? rov zevachim.
Rava amar, la kashya: kan – bekometz mincha leshum mincha, kan – bekometz mincha leshum zevach.
Mincha leshum mincha – "vezot torat hammincha", tora achat lechol hammenachot; mincha leshum zevach – "vezot torat hammincha vezevach" la ketiv.
Veha tanna "mippene shemmaaseha mochichin aleha" kaamar? hachi kaamar: af al gav demachshava dela minnachra hi, vetippesel, "vezot torat hammincha" – tora achat lechol hammenachot.
Umay aval bizvachim eno chen?
Af al gav dishchita achat lechullan, "vezot torat hammincha vezevach" la ketiv.

Ella meatta, chattat chelev sheshshechatah leshem chattat dam, leshum chattat avoda zara, leshum chattat nazir, leshum chattat metzora – tehe keshera uteratztze, deamar rachamana: "vezot torat hachattat", tora achat lechol chattaot!

Lerabbi shimon hachi name, lerabbanan ha amar: chattat chelev sheshshechatah leshem chattat dam, leshum chattat avoda zara – keshera, leshem chattat nazir metzora – pesula, dehane olot bahadayyhu ninhu.
Rav acha bereh derava matne leh lechullehu lifsula, "veshachat otah lechattat" – leshem oto chattat.
Rav ashe amar, la kashya: kan – bekometz minchat machavat leshum marcheshet, kan – bekometz minchat machavat leshum minchat marcheshet.
Minchat machavat leshum marcheshet – bemana ka mechashshev, umachshava bemana la pasla; minchat machavat leshum minchat marcheshet – bemincha defasla bah machshava ka mechashshev.
Veha tanna "mippene shemmaaseha mochichin aleha" kaamar? hachi kaamar: af al gav demachshava minnechar hi, tippesel.
Umay aval bizvachim eno chen? af al gav dishchita achat lechullan, zerika achat lechullan, kabbala achat lechullan – bizvicha defasla beh machshava ka mechashshev.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: chareva mishshum belula, ammay amar rabbi shimon? amar leh: leshum billa bealma.
I hachi, leshum shelamim name, leshum shelamim bealma?

Hachi hasheta? hatam zevach gufe ikkeri shelamim, dichtiv: "hammakriv et dam hashshelamim", "hazzorek et dam hashshelamim". hacha mincha gufa mi ikkeray belula? "vechol mincha velula vashshemen" ketiv, "belula vashshemen" ikkeray, "belula" setama la ikkeray.
Kullehu kerabba la amri, deadderabba, machshava deminnachra pesal rachamana.
Kerava la amri, "vezot torat" la mashma lehu.
Kerav ashe la amri, mishshum kusheya derav acha bereh derava.
Milleta difshita leh lerabba lehay gisa, ulerava lehay gisa, mibbaya leh lerav hoshaya. devae rav hoshaya, veamri la: bea minneh rav hoshaya merabbi assi: mincha leshum zevach

a: Ma li amar rabbi shimon? tama derabbi shimon mishshum machshava deminnachra la pasla, veha machshava deminnachra hu.
O dilma tama derabbi shimon mishshum dichtiv: "vezot torat hammincha", vezevach la ketiv. amar leh: kelum higganu lesof dato shel rabbi shimon?
Kerabba la meshanne leh, mishshum kusheya deabbaye.
Kerava la meshanne leh, mishshum kusheya "vezot torat hachattat".
Kerav ashe la meshanne leh, mishshum kusheya derav acha bereh derava.
Chutz mimminchat chote uminchat kenaot. bishlama minchat chote – "chattat" karyay rachamana, "lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona ki chattat hi vegomer", ella minchat kenaot menalan?
Detane tanna kammeh derav nachman: minchat kenaot motarah nedava.

Amar leh: shappir kaamrat, "mazkeret avon" ketiv bah, uvechattat ketiv: "veotah natan lachem laset et avon haeda", ma chattat motarah nedava – af minchat kenaot motarah nedava. vechachattat, ma chattat pesula shello lishmah – af minchat kenaot pesula shello lishmah.
Ella meatta, asham yehe pasul shello lishmo, degamar "avon" "avon" mechattat.
Danin "avon" meavon", veen danin "avono" meavon".
May nafka minna? veha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshav hakkohen" "uva hakkohen" – zo hi shiva zo hi bia.
Veod, ligmar "avono" "avono" meavon dishmiat hakkol, dichtiv: "im lo yaggid venasa avono".
Ella, ki gamri gezera shava, lemotar nedava hu degamri.

Vechi tema: en gezera shava lemechetza – galli rachamana gabbe chattat, "veshachat otah lechattat" – otah lishmah keshera, shello lishmah pesula. aval kol kadashim, ben lishman ben shello lishman – kesherim.
Ella, minchat chote uminchat kenaot difsulin shello lishman, menalan?
Chattat tama may, mishshum dichtiv ba "hi", hachi name, ha ketiv behu "hi".
Asham name, ha ketiv beh "hu", hahu "hu" leachar haketarat emurin hu dichtiv.
Kidtanya: aval asham lo neemar bo "hu" ella leachar haketarat emurin, hu atzmo shello huketru emurav kasher.
Veella "hu" lema li? lechidrav huna amar rav: asham shennittak liriyyay, ushechato setam – kasher leshum ola.
Nittak – in, lo nittak – la. amar kera: "hu", bahavayayto yehe.
Amar rav: minchat haomer shekkematzah shello lishmah – pesula, hoil uvat lehattir velo hittira. vechen atta omer baasham nazir
b: Vaasham metzora sheshshechatan shello lishman – pesulin, hoil uvau lehacheshir velo hichshiru.
Tenan: kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman – kesherot, ella shello alu labbealim leshum chova, chutz mimminchat chote uminchat kenaot. veim ita, litne name: "chutz mimminchat haomer"!
Ki katane baa yachid, baa tzibbur la katane; ki tane baa biglal atzmah, baa biglal zevach – la katane.
Ki katane hanach sheen kavua lahen zeman, ha dekavua lah zeman – la katane.
Amar mar: vechen atta omer baasham nazir vaasham metzora sheshshechatan shello lishman pesulin, hoil uvau lehacheshir velo hichshiru.

Tenan: kol hazzevachim sheshshechatan shello lishman kesherin, ella shello alu labbealim leshum chova, chutz mippesach vechattat. veim ita – litne name: chutz measham nazir vaasham metzora, devau lehacheshir velo hichshiru!
Kevan deikka asham gezelot vaasham meilot, dilchappara atu – la pesika leh.
May shena asham nazir vaasham metzora, devau lehacheshir velo hichshiru? hane name bau lechappara velo kipperu!

Amar rabbi yirmeya: matzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben mechapperim uven machshirin, mechapperin it behu deatu leachar mita, machshirin let behu deatu leachar mita. ditnan: haishsha shehevia chattatah umeta – yaviu yorshin olatah, olatah umeta – lo yaviu yorshin chattatah.

Matkef la rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: machshirin name, mi let behu deatu leachar mita? vehatnan: hammafrish maot linziruto – lo nehenin velo moalin, mippene sheruyin lavo kullan shelamim.
Met vehayu lo maot setumin – yippelu lindava; meforashin: deme chattat – yolich leyam hammelach, lo nehenin velo moalin; deme ola – yavi bahen ola, umoalin bahen.
Deme shelamim – yavi bahen shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veen teunin lechem. veha ola ushelamim denazir demachshirim ninhu, veka atu leachar mita!
Amar rav pappa: hachi ka amar rabbi yirmeya: lo matzinu hechsher kavua deva leachar mita, udenazir hechsher sheeno kavua hu,

a: Deamar mar: gillach al achat mishsheloshtan yatza.
Metivi: asham metzora shennishchat shello lishmo, o shello nittan middamo al gabbe behonot – hare ze ole legabbe mizbeach, vetaun nesachim, vetzarich asham acher lehacheshiro. teyuveta derav.
Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: minchat haomer shekkematzah shello lishmah – keshera, usheyareha en neechalin ad shettavi minchat haomer acheret vetattirenna.
Sheshsheyareha en neechalin ad shettavi minchat haomer acheret, mikrav hechi karva? "mimmashke yisrael" – min hammuttar leyisrael.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: kasavar resh lakish, en mechussar zeman levo bayyom.
Metiv rav adda bereh derav yitzchak: yesh baofot sheen bammenachot, yesh bammenachot sheen baofot. yesh baofot – shehaofot bain benidvat shenayim, aval menachot "nefesh" ketiva.
Umechussere chappara: zav, vezava, yoledet, umetzora.
Vehutteru mikkelal issuran bakkodesh, ma sheen ken bammenachot.
Veyesh bammenachot – shehammenachot teunot keli, utenufa vehaggasha, veyeshnan batztzibbur kevayyachid, ma sheen ken baofot.
Veim ita, bimnachot name mashkachat la, dehutteru mikkelal issuran bakkodesh, umay nihu? minchat haomer.
Kevan deen mechussar zeman levo bayyom, lav issura hu.

Metiv rav sheshet: hikdim mattan shemen lemattan dam – yemalleennu shemen veyachazor veyitten shemen achar mattan dam, mattan behonot lemattan sheva – yemalleennu shemen veyachazor veyitten mattan behonot achar mattan sheva.
Vei amrat en mechussar zeman levo bayyom, ammay yachzor veyitten? may daavad avad!
Amar rav pappa: shane hilchot metzora, dichtiva behu havayay, deamar hakkatuv: "zot tihye torat hammetzora", "tihye" – bahavayaytah tehe.
Metiv rav pappa: hikdim chattato laashamo – lo yihye acher memares bedamah, ella teubbar tzuratah vetetze levet hasserefa.

Ammay ka motev rav pappa? veha rav pappa hu deamar: shane hilchot metzora, dichtiva behu havayay! ella rav pappa hachi ka kashya leh: ema hane mille avoda, shechita lav avoda hi, vei en mechussar zeman levo bayyom – yehe acher memares bedamah, velakrev asham, vahadar laykrev chattat!
Ella amar rav pappa: hayeynu tama deresh lakish, dekasavar heir mizrach mattir, derabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: afillu bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym,
b: Heir mizrach mattir.
Veha deresh lakish lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar, ditnan: en meviin minchat bikkurim uminchat behema kodem laomer, devaenan "mimmashke yisrael", veim hevi – pasul.
Kodem lishte hallechem lo yavi, mishshum deikkeru "bikkurim", veim hevi – kasher.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella bearbaa asar uvachamishsha asar, aval beshishsha asar im hevi – kasher, vekashya li: lihvo kamchussar zeman! alma kasavar heir hammizrach mattir.

Verava amar: minchat haomer shekkematzah shello lishmah – keshera, usheyareha neechalin, veenah tzericha minchat haomer acheret lehattirah, sheen machshava moelet ella bemi sherauy laavoda, uvedavar harauy laavoda, uvimkom harauy laavoda.
Bemi sherauy laavoda – leappoke kohen baal mum, uvedavar harauy laavoda – leappoke minchat haomer dela chazya, dechiddush hu, uvimkom harauy laavoda – leappoke nifgam hammizbeach.
Tanu rabbanan: keshehu omer "min habbakar" lematta, sheen talmud lomar, ella lehotzi et hatterefa.
Vahalo din hu: uma baal mum shemmutteret lahedyot – asura laggavoah, terefa sheasura lahedyot – en din sheasura laggavoah? chelev vadam yochichu, sheasurin lahedyot umuttarin laggavoah!
Ma lechelev vadam, shekken bain mikkelal hetter, tomar bitrefa shekkullah asura, velo tehe mutteret laggavoah!
Melika tochiach, shekkullah issur, vaasura lahedyot, umutteret laggavoah.

Ma limlika, shekken kedushshatah osartah, bishat kedushshatah lammizbeach hi neesra lahedyot, dehayynu melikatah, aval kodem lachen lo neesra lahedyot, ma sheen ken bitrefa, sheen kedushshatah osartah!
Veim heshavta, keshehu omer "min habbakar" lematta, sheen talmud lomar, lehotzi et hatterefa.
Ma "im heshavta"? (siman: rekiach, mar, adda, leshesheh).
Amar rav, mishshum deikka lememar: minchat haomer tochiach, sheasura lahedyot umutteret laggavoah. ma leminchat haomer, shekken matteret chadash!
Bashsheviit – sheviit name, shekken matteret sefichin bashsheviit, kerabbi akiva, deamar: sefichin asurim bishviit.
Amar leh rav acha bar abba lerav ashe: lerabbi akiva name lifroch, ma leminchat haomer shekken matteret chadash bechutza laaretz?
Vaafillu leman deamar: chadash bechutz laaretz lav deorayyta, shekken baa lehattir lav shebbetochah.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: i hachi, terefa name tikrav vetattir lav shebbetochah! ella parech hachi: ma leminchat haomer, shekken mitzvatah bechach.
Resh lakish amar: mishshum deikka lememar mefattem hakketoret yochiach, sheasur lahedyot umuttar laggavoah. mefattem gavra hu!
Ella, pittum hakketoret yochiach, sheasur lahedyot umuttar laggavoah. ma lefittum hakketoret, shekken mitzvato bechach.
Mar bereh deravina amar, mishshum deikka lememar: shabbat tochiach, sheasura lahedyot umutteret laggavoah.
Ma leshabbat, shekken huttera mikkelalah etzel hedyot bemila!
Attu mila tzorech hedyot hu? mila mitzva hi! ella, ma leshabbat shekken mitzvatah bechach.
Rav adda bar abba amar: mishshum deikka lememar, kilayim tochiach, sheasurin lahedyot umuttarin laggavoah.
Ma lechilayim, shekken hutteru mikkelalan etzel hedyot betzitzit? attu tzitzit tzorech hedyot hi? mitzva hi! ella

a: Ma lechilayim shemmitzvato bechach.
Rav shisha bereh derav idi amar: mishshum deikka lememar, lihdar dina vetete bamma hatztzad" – ma limlika shekken kedushshatah osartah, chelev vadam yochichu.
Ma lechelev vadam, shekken baim mikkelal hetter – melika tochiach.

Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze chiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheasurin lahedyot umuttarin laggavoah, af ani avi terefa – af al pi sheasura lahedyot tehe mutteret laggavoah, ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken mitzvatah bechach!
Ella amar rav ashe, mishshum deikka lememar: meikkara dedina pircha, mehecha ka mayytet la? mibbaal mum –
Ma levaal mum, shekken asa bo makrivin kikrevin.
Amar leh rav acha sava lerav ashe: yotze dofen yochiach, shello asa bo makrivin kikrevin, umuttar lahedyot veasur laggavoah.
Ma leyotze dofen, shekken eno kadosh bivchora.
Baal mum yochiach, ma levaal mum shekken asa bo makrivin kikrevin, yotze dofen yochiach.
Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shemmuttarin lahedyot vaasurim laggavoah, vechol shekken terefa sheasura lahedyot tehe asura laggavoah.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken lo hutteru mikkelalan, tomar bitrefa shehuttera mikkelalah.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: terefa shehuttera mikkelalah may hi? ilema melika deolat haof laggavoah, baal mum name beofot ishteroye ishteri, tammut vezachrut babbehema, veen tammut vezachrut baofot!
Ella, melika dechattat haof lakkohanim – kohanim mishshulechan gavoah ka zachu.
Veella parech hachi: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken muman nikkar, tomar bitrefa shekken en mumah nikkar! mishshum hachi itzterich kera.
Uterefa mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka: "mimmashke yisrael" – min hammuttar leyisrael!
Mikkol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet" – nafka, perat latterefa sheenah overet.

Tzerichi, dei mimmashke yisrael" hava amena lemaote hecha delo hayta lah sheat hakkosher, dumya deorla vechile hakkerem, aval hayta lah sheat hakkosher ema tittachshar, ketav rachamana "kol asher yaavor".

Vei ketav rachamana "kol asher yaavor", hava amena lemaote hecha denitrefa ulevassof hikdishah, dumya demaaser. aval hikdishah ulevassof nitrefa, dividdana deakdesha hava chazya, ema tittachshar. ketav rachamana "min habbakar", tzerichi.

Mishna echad minchat chote veechad kol hammenachot, shekkematzan zar, onen, tevul yom, mechussar begadim, mechussar kippurim, shello rachatz yadav veraglav, arel, tame, yoshev, omed al gabbe chelim, al gabbe vehema, al gabbe ragle chavero – pasul.
Kamatz bismol – pasul, ben betira omer: yachzir veyachazor veyikmotz beyamin.

Kamatz veala beyado tzeror, o garger melach, o koret shel levona – pasul, mippene sheamru: hakkometz hayyater vehechaser – pasul. veezehu hayyater – shekkematzo mevoratz, vechaser – shekkematzo berashe etzbeotav.
Gemara lema li lemitna "echad minchat chote veechad kol hammenachot"? litne "kol hammenachot shekkematzan zar veonen"!

Lerabbi shimon itzterich, detanya: amar rabbi shimon: bedin hu shettehe minchat chote teuna shemen ulevona, shello yehe chote niskar, umippene ma enah teuna? shello yehe korbano mehuddar, uvaddin hu shettehe chattat chelev teuna nesachim,
b: Shello yehe chote niskar, umippene ma enah teuna? shello yehe korbano mehuddar. salka datach amena: hoil veamar rabbi shimon shello yehe korbano mehuddar, ki kamtzi la pesulin name tittachshar, ka mashma lan.
I hachi, hatam name litne: echad chattat chelev veechad kol hazzevachim shekkibbelu daman zar veonen, velema: lerabbi shimon itzterich.
Alma, kevan ditna leh "kol" vela katane "chutz" – kullehu mashma, hacha name, kevan ditna "kol" vela katane "chutz" – kullehu mashma.
Itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil veokemna leresha dela kerabbi shimon, sefa name dela kerabbi shimon, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav: zar shekkamatz – yachzir, veha anan "pasal" tenan? may "pasal"? pasal ad sheyyachazir.

I hachi, hayeynu ben betira? i deiteh lekometz beeneh – la peligi rabbanan aleh deven betira, ki peligi – dachasar kometz. rabbanan savri: la yavi mittoch beto vimalleennu, ben betira savar: yavi mittoch beto vimalleennu.
I hachi, ben betira omer: yachzir veyachazor veyikmotz beyamin?! ben betira omer: yachzir veyavi mittoch beto vimalleennu, veyachazor veyikmotz beyamin, mibbee leh!
Ki ka amar rav leven betira, peshita! mahu detema: ad kan la ka machshar ben betira ella bismol, aval bishar pesulin la, ka mashma lan.
May shena semol, deashkechan le hechshera beyom hakkippurim? zar name ashkechan le hechshera bishchita!
Shechita lav avoda hi.
Vela? vehaamar rabbi zera amar rav: shechitat para bezar pesula, veamar rav ala: "elazar" vechukka" ketiv ba. shane para, dekodshe bedek habbayit hi.
Velav kol dechen hu? kodshe bedek habbayit bau kehunna, kodshe mizbeach la bau kehunna?! amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: midde dehave ammarot negaim, delav avoda ninhu uvae kehunna.
Venelaf mibbama?
Vechi tema, mibbama la yalfinan, vehatanya: minnayin layyotze, sheim ala lo yered, shehare yotze kasher bevama!
Tena azzot torat haola" semich leh.

Ella tama deashmeinan rav, ha lav hachi hava amena bishar pesulin pasal ben betira? vehatanya: rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon omrim: machshir haya ben betira bechol happesulin kullan!
Vetanya: "vekamatz mishsham" – mimmakom sheragle hazzar omdot.
Ben betira omer, minnayin sheim kamatz bismol sheyyachazir veyachazor veyikmotz beyamin? talmud lomar: "vekamatz mishsham", mimmakom shekkamatz kevar.
Vechevan dikra setama ketiv ba, ma li semol, uma li shear happesulin?

Ella, ha kamashma lan rav: kamatz vaafillu kiddesh, uleappoke mehane tannae detanya: rabbi yose ben yose ben yasyayn verabbi yehuda hannachtom amru: bamme devarim amurim – shekkamatz velo kiddesh, aval kiddesh – pasal.
Veikka deamri: kamatz – in, kiddesh – la. keman? kehane tannae, uleappoke mittanna kamma.
Matkef la rav nachman: may ka savri hane tannae? i kemitzat pesulin avoda hi, af al gav dela aved leh mattan keli! i kemitzat pesulin lav avoda hi, ki avad le mattan keli may hava?
Hadar amar rav nachman: leolam avoda hi, vela gamra avodatah ad deaved le mattan keli.
I hachi, afillu lo kiddesh,

a: Vechi mahdar leh lekometz leducheteh, (tikdosh) [likdosh] velifsol.
Amar rabbi yochanan, zot omeret: kele sharet en mekaddeshin ella middaat.

Ha middaat mekaddeshin? veha bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: kele sharet mahu sheyyekaddeshu pesulin lechattechilla likrav? vaamar leh: en mekaddeshin! amar leh: en mekaddeshin likrav, aval mikkaddeshin lippasel.
Rav amram amar: kegon shehechziro levisa gedusha.
Umikmatz hechi kematz? ella, kegon shehechziro levisa tefufa.
Vechevan dikmatz leh avad leh gumma, ki mahdar legavvevy demana ka mahdar leh! mikki mahdar leh, mannach leh addufna demana, umenid leh venafel mimmela, denaasa kemi shehechziro hakkof.

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: velokma kegon shehechziro lichli hammunnach al gabbe karka! ella, shema minna komtzin mikkeli sheal gabbe karka? amar leh: ka nagat bevaya deibbaya lan, derabbi avimi tane menachot be rav chisda.
Vaavimi be rav chisda tane? vehaamar rav chisda: kulefe tave belai meavimi ala deha shemata, ba lehacheriz retzufin – sheloshim yom, sheni vachamishi vesheni – shishshim yom.
Avimi massechta itakara (itakar) leh, vaata kammeh derav chisda leiddechore gemareh. velishlach leh velete legabbeh? sevar: hachi mistayyeya milleta tefe.
Pega beh rav nachman, amar leh: ketzad komtzin? amar leh: mikkeli ze. amar leh: vechi komtzin mikkeli sheal gabbe karka? amar leh: demagba leh kohen.
Ketzad mekaddeshin et hammenachot? amar leh: notnah lichli ze. vechi mekaddeshin bichli sheal gabbe karka? amar leh: demagba leh kohen.
Amar leh: im ken, hutzerachta shelosha kohanim! amar leh: utehe tzericha shelosha asar, kattamid.
Etiveh: ze hakkelal, kol hakkometz venoten bichli, hammolich vehammaktir, leechol davar sheddarko leechol vechulei.
Veillu magbiah la katane? tanna seder avodot naket, vela seder kohanim.

Beo minneh midderav sheshet: mahu likmotz mikkeli sheal gabbe karka? amar leh: pok chazi ma avdin legav. arbaa kohanim nichnasin, shenayim beyadam shene sedarim, ushenayim beyadam shene bazichin, vearbaa mekaddemin lifnehem, shenayim littol shene sedarim, ushenayim littol shene bazichin.
b: Veillu magbiah et hashshulechan la katane.
Lav amrat hatam, seder avodot naket? hacha name seder avodot naket.
Mi dame? hatam la nachet leminyayna dechohanim, hacha nachet leminyayna dechohanim. im ita – litne magbiah! ella shema minna: komtzin mikkeli sheal gabbe karka. shema minna.
Amar rava: peshita li, kometz mikkeli sheal gabbe karka – shekken matzinu besilluk bazichin. mekaddeshin mincha bichli sheal gabbe karka – shekken matzinu besiddur bazichin.
Bae rava: kiddush kometz may? mimmincha yalfinan la, o middam yalfinan la? hadar pashta: middam yalfinan la.
Umi amar rava hachi? veha ittemar: kometz shechilleko bishne kelim, rav nachman amar: eno kadosh, verava amar: kadosh. veim ita, lelaf middam! hadar beh rava mehahi.
Vadam menalan dela kadosh lachatzain? detane rav tachlifa ben shaul: kiddesh pachot mikkede hazzaa bichli ze, ufachot mikkede hazzaa bichli ze – lo kiddesh.
Veibbaya lehu: bedam may? hilcheta hi, umehilcheta la yalfinan.
O dilma hatam may tama – dichtiv "vetaval bammayim", hacha name hachtiv "vetaval baddam"?
Veittemar, amar rabbi zerika amar rabbi elazar: af bedam lo kiddesh. amar rava: tanya name hachi, bifne kohen manniach, "vetaval" velo mesappeg.
"Baddam" – sheyyehe baddam shiur tevila meikkaro, "min haddam" – min haddam shebbainyan.

Veitzterich lemichtav "vetaval", veitzterich lemichtav "baddam", dei ketav rachamana "vetaval" hava amena: af al gav delo kibbel shiur tevilot, dehayynu hazzaa sheva peamim meikkaro, ketav rachamana "baddam".
Vei ketav rachamana "baddam", hava amena afillu mesappeg, ketav rachamana "vetaval".
"Min haddam" shebbainyan, lemaote may? amar rava: lemaote shirayim shebbaetzba, mesayyay leh lerabbi elazar, deamar: shirayim shebbaetzba pesulin.
Amar leh ravin bar rav adda lerava: amri talmidach amar rav amram, tanya: haya mazze venitteza hazzaa miyyado, im ad shello hizza – taun kibbus, mishshehizza – en taun kibbus.
May lav ad shello gamar hazzaato, umishsheggamar hazzaato? shema minna deshirayim shebbaetzba kesherim.
Lo, ad shello yatzta miyyado hazzaa – taun kibbus, umishsheyyatza hazzaa miyyado venitteza mimma shennishar – en taun kibbus.
Etiveh abbaye: gamar millehazzot – mekanneach yado begufah shel para. gamar – in, lo gamar – la.
Amar leh: gamar – mekanneach yado, lo gamar – mekanneach etzbao.

Bishlama gamar mekanneach yado begufah shel para, dichtiv: "vesaraf et happara leenav", ella lo gamar mekanneach etzbao, bemay mekanneach? dei amrat begufah shel para, ibbei leh lemitne: mekanneach yado veetzbao begufah shel para! middela katane hachi, shema minna dela bae kinnuach.
Amar abbaye: bisfat mizrak, kedichtiv: "kefore zahav vegomer".
Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi? veha ittemar: chavitte kohen gadol – rabbi yochanan amar: enah kedosha lachatzain, rabbi elazar amar: mittoch shekkereva lachatzain, kedosha lachatzain.

a: Veim ita, lelaf middam? vechi tema: rabbi elazar milleta mimmilleta la gamar? veha amar rabbi elazar: mincha shekkematzah bahechol keshera, shekken matzinu besilluk bazichin.
Mincha mimmincha yalef, mincha middam la yalef.

Umincha mimmincha mi yalef? vehatanya: ad shello perkah nifras lachmah – hallechem pasul, veen maktir alav et habbazichin. mishshepperkah nifras lachmah – hallechem pasul, umaktir alav et habbazichin.
Veamar rabbi elazar: lo perkah mammash, ella kevan shehiggia zemannah lefarek, af al pi shello perkah, kemi shepperkah damya.
Veammay? tehve kemincha shechasra kodem kemitza!
Ha la kashya, mincha la berir (berera) kometz dida, veha berir (berera) kometz dida, vechevan shehiggia zemannah lefarek – keman defarka damya.

Ella meatta, tehve keshirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaketara, deen maktirin kometz alehen! lav pelugeta ninhu? rabbi elazar savar la keman deamar: shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaketara – maktir kometz alehen.

Gufa: chavitte kohen gadol, rabbi yochanan amar: enah kedosha lachatzain, verabbi elazar amar: mittoch shekkereva lachatzain, kedosha lachatzain. amar rabbi acha: may tama derabbi yochanan? amar kera: "mincha machatzitah", have mincha veachar kach chotzehu.

Metivi: chavitte kohen gadol lo hayu baot chatzain, ella mevi issaron shalem vechotzehu; vetanya: illu neemar "mincha machatzit", hayiti omer: mevi chatzi issaron mibbeto shacharit umakriv, chatzi issaron mibbeto arvit umakriv; talmud lomar "machatzitah babboker" – mechetza mishshalem hu mevi.
Lemitzva. amar leh rav geviha mibbe chetil lerav ashe: veha "chukka" ketiv ba, amar leh: lo nitzrecha ella lahaviah shalem mibbeto.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? veha ittemar: hifrish chatzi issaron, vedato lehosif – rav amar: eno kadosh, verabbi yochanan amar: kadosh. veim ita, lelaf mechavittin!
Vechi tema, rabbi yochanan milleta mimmilleta la yalef, vehaamar rabbi yochanan: shelamim sheshshechatan bahechol kesherin, dichtiv: "ushechato petach ohel moed", shello yehe tafel chamur meikkar.

Dato lehosif shane, detanya: "meleim" – en "meleim" ella shelemim (kelomar sheeno kadosh ad sheyyehe issaron shalem), veamar rabbi yose: ematay? bizman sheen dato lehosif, aval bizman sheddato lehosif – rishon rishon kadosh.
Verav, bechavitin keman sevira leh? i kerabbi elazar, lelaf mechavittin!
Vechi tema rav milleta mimmilleta la yalef, vehaamar rav: mincha kedosha belo shemen (uvelo levona) – shekken matzinu belechem happanim. belo levona – shekken matzinu beminchat nesachim.
Belo shemen uvelo levona – shekken matzinu beminchat chote, al korchaych rav kerabbi yochanan sevira leh.

Gufa, amar rav: mincha kedosha belo shemen, veen dina keissaron chaser – shekken matzinu belechem happanim. belo levona – shekken matzinu beminchat nesachim. belo shemen uvelo levona – shekken matzinu beminchat chote.
Veshemen ulevona kodshi hay bela hay vehay bela hay; shemen – shekken matzinu belog shemen shel metzora, levona – shekken matzinu bilvona habbaa bevazichin, verabbi chanina amar:
b: Lo zo kedosha belo zo velo zo kedosha belo zo.
Ulerabbi chanina, issaron lamma nimshach? (vahalo eno asuy ella limdidat kemach bilvad, vehakkemach eno kadosh belo shemen!) leminchat chote.
Velog, lamma nimshach? lelog shel metzora.

Veaf shemuel savar la leha derav, ditnan: kele hallach mekaddeshin et hallach, umiddot hayyavesh mekaddeshin et hayyavesh, veen kele hallach mekaddeshin et hayyavesh, velo middot hayyavesh mekaddeshin et hallach.
Veamar shemuel: lo shanu ella middot, aval mizrakot (shel dam) mekaddeshot et hayyavesh, shenneemar: "shenehem meleim solet belula vashshemen lemincha".
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: mincha lacha hi! amar leh: lo nitzrecha ella layyavesh shebbah, (dehayynu levona.

Vei salka datach kasavar shemuel: en mincha kedosha ad sheyyehu kullan, yavesh shebbah hechi mashkachat la? vahalo kullan lachim hen mippene hashshemen! ella shema minna kasavar shemuel: hay belo hay.)
Veibbaet ema: mincha, legabbe dam – keyavesh damya.
Gufa, amar rabbi elazar: mincha shekkematzah bahechol – keshera, shekken matzinu besilluk bazichin.
Metiv rabbi yirmeya: "vekamatz mishsham" – mimmakom sheragle hazzar omdot.
Ben betira omer: minnayin sheim kamatz bismol, sheyyachazir veyikmotz beyamin? talmud lomar: "vekamatz mishsham" – mimmakom shekkamatz kevar.

Ikka deamri: hu motev la vehu mefarek la. ikka deamri: amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa, asbera lach – lo nitzrecha ella lehacheshir et kol azara kullah, shello tomar: hoil veola kodshe kadashim, umincha kodshe kadashim, ma ola teuna tzafon – af mincha teuna tzafon.
Ma leola, shekken kalil, mechattat.
Ma lechattat, shekken mechapperet al chayyayve charetot, measham.
Ma leasham, shekken mine damim! mikkullehu name, shekken mine damim!

Ella itzterich, salka datach amena, hoil uchetiv: "vehikrivah el hakkohen vehiggishah el hammizbeach vekamatz", ma haggasha bekeren deromit maaravit, af kemitza name bekeren deromit maaravit, ka mashma lan.
Gufa, amar rabbi yochanan: shelamim sheshshechatan bahechol – kesherin, shenneemar: "ushechato petach ohel moed", velo yehe tafel chamur min haikkar.
Metivi: rabbi yehuda ben betira omer, minnayin sheim hikkifu goyim et haazara, shehakkohanim nichnasin lahechol veochlin bekodshe kadashim usheyare menachot? talmud lomar:

a: "Bekodesh hakkodashim tochlennu".
Veha lema li kera? lema: "bachatzar ohel moed yochluha", velo yehe tafel chamur min haikkar.

Avoda, deadam oved bimkom rabbo, amrinan shello yehe tafel chamur min haikkar. achila, sheen adam ochel bimkom rabbo, tama dichtav kera, ha la ketav kera – lo yehe tafel chamur min haikkar la amrinan.

Ittemar: belalah chutz lechomat azara, rabbi yochanan amar: pesula, resh lakish amar: keshera. resh lakish amar keshera, dichtiv: "veyatzak aleha shemen venatan aleha levona", vahadar "veheviah el bene aharon hakkohanim vekamatz".
Mikkemitza veelach mitzvat kehunna, limmed al yetzika uvelila shekkesherin bezar, umiddichhunna la baaya, penim name la baaya.
Verabbi yochanan amar: pesula, kevan daasiyyaytah bichli hu, nehi dichhunna la baaya, penim mihat baaya. tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: belalah zar – keshera, chutz lechomat haazara – pesula.
Ittemar: mincha shechasra kodem kemitza, rabbi yochanan amar: yavi mittoch beto vimalleenna, resh lakish amar: la yavi mittoch beto vimalleenna.
Rabbi yochanan amar: mevi mittoch beto vimalleenna, kemitza kava leh. resh lakish amar: la yavi mittoch beto vimalleenna, kedushshat keli kava leh.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish: chaser hallog, im ad shello yatzak – yemalleennu, teyuveta.

Ittemar: shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaketara, rabbi yochanan amar: maktir kometz alehen, veresh lakish amar: en maktir kometz alehen. allibba derabbi eliezer kulle alma la peligi, ki peligi allibba derabbi yehoshua.
Ditnan: nitmeu sheyareha, nisrefu sheyareha, avdu sheyareha – kemiddat rabbi eliezer keshera, kemiddat rabbi yehoshua pesula.
Man defasel – kerabbi yehoshua, uman demachshar – ad kan lo amar rabbi yehoshua hatam ella dela ishteyayr, aval hecha deishteyayr – afillu rabbi yehoshua mode leh.
Detanya: rabbi yehoshua omer: kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer mehem kezayit basar o kezayit chelev – zorek haddam, kachatzi zayit basar kachatzi zayit chelev – eno zorek et haddam.
Uvaola, afillu kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev – zorek et haddam, mippene shebbaola kullah kalil, uvammincha, af al pi shekkullah kayyemet – lo yizrok.
b: Mincha may avidte? amar rav pappa: minchat nesachim.
Salka datach amena: hoil uvahade zevach atya – ki gufeh dezevach damya, ka mashma lan.
Uman defasel – shane hacha, deamar kera: "veherim hakkohen min hammincha et azkaratah vehiktir hammizbecha", "hammincha" – ad deita lechulla mincha lo yaktir.
Veiddach, "min hammincha" – mincha shehayta kevar shelema bishat kemitza yaktir, af al gav dehashta enah shelema.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: ad shello perkah nifras hallechem – pasul, veen maktir alav et habbazichin, veim mishshepperkah nifras lachmah – hallechem pasul, umaktir alav et habbazichin. veamar rabbi elazar: lo perkah mammash, ella kevan shehiggia zemannah lefarek, veaf al pi shello pirkah.
Amar leh: ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi. amar leh: ana amena lach mishna shelema, veamrat li at rabbi eliezer?
I rabbi eliezer, may irya nifras? afillu saruf veavud name machshar! ishtik.
Veammay shetek? lema leh: tzibbur shane, hoil veishteray tumea legabbayyhu – ishteray name chaserot! amar rav adda bar ahava: zot omeret, hachesron kevaal mum dame, veen baal mum batztzibbur.
Yatev rav pappa vekaamar leha shemata, amar leh rav yosef bar shemaya lerav pappa: mi la askinan derabbi yochanan veresh lakish beminchat haomer detzibbur hi, ufeligi?
Amar rav malkiyyo, tana chada: "missoltah" – sheim chasra kol shehu pesula, "mishshamnah" – sheim chasra kol shehu pasul.
Vetanya iddach: "vehannoteret min hammincha" – perat lammincha shechasra hi, veshechasar kumetzah, veshello hiktir millevonatah kelum.
Tere kerae bachaserot lema li? lav chad lemincha shechasra kodem kemitza, vechad leshirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaketara,
Uteyuveta derabbi yochanan betarvayyhu?

La, chad lemincha shechasra kodem kemitza, dei mevi mibbeto vimalleenna – in, vei la – la, vechad leshirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaketara, deaf al gav demaktir kometz alehen – otan shirayim asurim laachila.
Deibbaya lehu: ledivre haomer shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaketara maktir kometz alehen, otan shirayim ma hen baachila?
Amar zeeri, amar kera: "vehannoteret", velo hannoteret min hannoteret. verabbi yannay amar: "mehammincha" – mincha shehayta kevar.

Kamatz bismol – mena hane mille? amar rabbi zera, deamar kera: "vayyakrev et hammincha vaymalle chappo mimmenna" – kaf ze eni yodea mahu, keshehu omer: "velakach hakkohen millog hashshamen veyatzak al kaf hakkohen hassemalit" – kan semalit, ha kol makom shenneemar "kaf" eno ella yamin.
Veha mibbee leh legufeh? "semalit" acharina ketiv.
Veema: en miut achar miut ella lerabbot? "semalit" acharina ketiv. kan semalit, veen acher semalit.
Veema: adderabba, ma kan semalit – af bealma name semalit! arbaa "semalit" ketivi: tere beani, utere beashir.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: "al bohen yado hayemanit veal bohen raglo hayemanit" dichtiv beshemen dimtzora ashir lema li?

a: (Deha ketiv "al dam haasham"!), chad lehacheshir tzedadin, vechad lifsol tzidde tzedadin.
"Al dam haasham", (al) [veal] mekom dam haasham" – lemay atu?
Hane tzerichi, i ketav rachamana "al dam haasham", hava amena: iteh – in, nitkanneach – la, ketav rachamana "al mekom".
Vei ketav rachamana "al mekom", hava amena: davka nitkanneach, aval iteh – ema have chatzitza, ka mashma lan "al dam haasham".
Amar rava: meachar dichtiv "al dam haasham" veal mekom [dam] haasham", uchetiva yemanit bedam "al bohen yado hayemanit veal bohen raglo hayemanit", uchetivi beshemen dimtzora ashir veani, lema li?
Ella amar rava: "yad" "yad" likmitza.
"Regel" "regel" lachalitza.
"Ozen" "ozen" lirtzia.

"Semalit" (heani) lemay ata? amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: lifsol yamin dechohen bimtzora, shello tomar: uma bimkom shello nitrabbeta semol nitrabbeta yamin, bemakom shennitrabbeta semol eno din shennitrabbeta yamin?
Veiddach "semalit" (veyad varegel yemanit deani), lemay ata? lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael: kol parasha shenneemra venishnet, lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah.
Amar rabba bar bar chana, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kol makom shenneemra etzba uchehunna, enah ella yamin.

Ka salka datin, etzba uchehunna baenan, kedichtiv: "velakach hakkohen middam hachattat beetzbao", vegamar mimmetzora, dichtiv: "vetaval hakkohen et etzbao hayemanit". hare kemitza dela ketiva bah ella kehunna, utenan: kamatz bismol pasul!
Amar rava: o "etzba" o "kehunna".

Amar leh abbaye: hare holachat evarim lakkevesh, dichtiv behu kehunna, dichtiv: "vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha", veamar mar: zo holachat evarim lakkevesh, utenan: haregel shel yamin bismol uvet orah lachutz.
Ki amrinan "o etzba o kehunna" – bedavar hameakkev kappara.

Vahare kabbala (davar) [dedavar] hameakkev kappara hu, uchetiv bah kehunna, dichtiv: "vehikrivu bene aharon hakkohanim et haddam" – zo kabbalat haddam, utenan: kibbel bismol pasal, verabbi shimon machshir.
Lerabbi shimon kaamrat? rabbi shimon tarte bae.
Umi bae rabbi shimon tarte? vehatanya: rabbi shimon omer: kol makom shenneemra "yad" – enah ella yamin, "etzba" – enah ella yamin! etzba la baaya kehunna, kehunna baaya etzba.
Ella kohen lema li? bechihuno.
b: Vahare zerika dela ketiv bay ella kehunna, utenan: zarak bismol pasul, vela pelig rabbi shimon? amar abbaye: pelig bevarayyta, detanya: kibbel bismol pasul, verabbi shimon machshir; zarak bismol pasul, verabbi shimon machshir.
Veella, ha deamar rava: "yad" "yad" likmitza, lema li? mikkehunna nafka!
Chad lekometz, vechad lekiddush kometz.
Lerabbi shimon dela bae kiddush kometz, uleman deamar name devae kiddush kometz lerabbi shimon, uvismol achshore machshar – "yad" "yad" derava lema li?

I likmitza gufa, allibba derabbi shimon, midderabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay nafka, deamar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: may tama derabbi shimon? deamar kera: "kodesh kadashim hi kachattat vechaasham".
Ba leovdah bayyad – ovdah beyamin, kechattat; ba leovdah bichli – ovdah bismol, keasham.
Lo nitzrecha ella lekometz deminchat chote, salka datach amena: hoil veamar rabbi shimon shello yehe korbano mehuddar, ki kametz la name bismol tittachshar, kamashma lan.
Kamatz veala beyado tzeror, o garger melach,

a: O koret levona – pasul. kol hane lema li?
Tzericha, dei tena tzeror – mishshum delav bat hakerava hi, aval melach devat hakerava hi – ema tittachshar.
Vei tena melach, dela ikkeva bahade mincha meikkara (sheeno moleach ella hakkometz bilvad), aval levona deikkeva bahade mincha meikkara – ema tittachshar, ka mashma lan.
Mippene sheamru: hakkometz hechaser o hayyater pasul. may irya mishshum chaser veyater? vetippok leh mishshum chatzitza! amar rabbi yirmeya: min hatztzad.
Amar leh abbaye lerava: ketzad komtzin? amar leh: kidkamtzi inashe. etiveh: zo zeret, zo kemitza.
Zo amma, zo etzba, zo gudal.
Ella lehashevot, (kelomar, kometz melo hayyad kede shello yehe chaser, veachar kach mochek beetzba ketanna millematta).
Hechi aved? amar rav zutera bar toviyya, amar rav: chofe shelosh etzbeotav, ad shemmaggia al pas yado, vekometz.
Tanya name hachi: "melo kumtzo" – yachol mevoratz? talmud lomar "bekumtzo".
I bekumtzo, yachol berashe etzbeotav? talmud lomar: "melo kumtzo", ha ketzad? chofe shelosh etzbeotav al pas yado vekometz.
Bemachavat uvemarcheshet, mochek begudalo millemala uveetzbao ketanna millematta, vezo hi avoda kasha shebbammikdash.
Zehu vetu la? vehaikka melika, vehaikka chafina! ella zo hi achat meavodot kashot shebbammikdash.
Amar rav pappa: peshita li, "melo kumtzo" kidkamtzi inashe. bae rav pappa: kamatz berashe etzbeotav, may?
Min hatztzedadin, may? mimmatta lemala, may? teku.
Amar rav pappa: peshita li, "melo chofnav" kidchafni inashe. bae rav pappa: chafan berashe etzbeotav mahu? min hatztzedadin mahu? chafan bezo uvazo vekervan zo etzel zo mahu? teku.
Bae rav pappa: dabbekeh lekometz bedafneh demana, may? toch keli baenan, vehaikka, o dilma hannacha betocho baenan, velekka? teku.
Bae mar bar rav ashe: hafecheh lemana, vedabbekeh lekometz bearita demana, may? hannacha betocho baenan, vehaikka, o dilma ketikno bainan, velekka? teku.
Mishna ketzad hu ose? poshet et etzbeotav al pas yado. ribba shamnah, chisser shamnah, chisser levonatah – pesula.
Gemara hechi dame ribba shamnah? amar rabbi eliezer: kegon shehifrish lah shene luggin. velokma kegon dearev bah shemen dechullin vashemen dachaverta!
Vechi tema, shemen dechullin vashemen dachaverta la pasel, matkef la rav zutera bar toviyya: ella meatta, minchat chote defasel bah shemen, hechi mashkachat la?
I dida – ha let la, i dechullin vedachaverta – ha amrat la pasel, (vei amrat deafresh le shemen – kevan delet le shemen kelal, chullin ninhu).
Verabbi eliezer la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya dechullin vedachaverta defasel, aval hifrish lah shene luggin, hoil vehay chaze leh vehay chaze leh, ema la lippesil – ka mashma lan.
Umena leh lerabbi eliezer ha? amar rava: matnitin keshiteh, may irya detane "ribba shamnah"? litne "ribba lah shemen"! ella ha ka mashma lan, deaf al gav dehifrish lah shene luggin.
Chisser levonatah. tanu rabbanan: chasra veamda al koret echad – pesula, al shene keratin – keshera, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: al koret echad – keshera, pachot mikkan – pesula.
b: Vehatanya (rabbi shimon omer): kometz levona shechasar kol shehu – pasul. teni: koret levona shechasar kol shehu – pasul. veibbaet ema: kan bilvona habbaa im hammincha, kan bilvona habbaa bifne atzmah.

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef, amar rabbi yochanan: shalosh machlokot baddavar, rabbi meir savar: kometz battechilla vekometz bassof, verabbi yehuda savar: kometz battechilla ushene keratin bassof, verabbi shimon savar: kometz battechilla vekoret echad bassof.

Usheloshtan mikra echad darshu, "veet kol hallevona asher al hammincha". rabbi meir savar: ad deita lilvona deikkevaa bahade mincha meikkara, verabbi yehuda savar: "kol" – vaafillu chad koret, "et" – lerabbot koret acher, verabbi shimon "et" la daresh.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef, amar rabbi yochanan: machloket bilvona habbaa im hammincha, aval bilvona habbaa bifne atzmah – divre hakkol kometz battechilla vekometz bassof. lehachi itzterich "asher al hammincha", devahade mincha – in, bifne atzmah – la.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef, amar rabbi yochanan: machloket bilvona habbaa im hammincha, aval bilvona habbaa bevazichin – divre hakkol shene kematzin battechilla, ushene kematzin bassof.
Peshita, mahu detema: kevan devahade lechem atya, kaasher al hammincha" damya, ka mashma lan.

Peligi ba rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha, chad amar: machloket bilvona habbaa im hammincha, aval bilvona habbaa bifne atzmah – divre hakkol kometz battechilla vekometz bassof, vechad amar: kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo.
Chisser levonatah – ha yater keshera, vehatanya: yater pesula! amar rame bar chama: kegon shehifrish lah shene kematzin.
Veamar rame bar chama: hifrish lah shene kematzin, veavad echad mehen kodem kemitza – lo hukebu, achar kemitza – hukebu.
Veamar rame bar chama: hifrish arbaa kematzin lishne bazichin, veavdu shenayim mehen kodem silluk bazichin – la hukebu, leachar silluk bazichin – hukebu.
Ha tu lema li? hayeynu hach!
Mahu detema: kevan divrir kometz dida, kevan shehiggia zemannah leforkah – keman difrika damya, ka mashma lan.

Mishna hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha bachutz, o kezayit mishsheyareha bachutz, lehaketir kumetzah bachutz, o kezayit kumetzah bachutz, o lehaketir levonatah bachutz – pasul, veen bo karet. leechol sheyareha lemachar, o kezayit mishsheyareha lemachar, lehaketir kumetzah lemachar, o kezayit mikkumetzah lemachar, o lehaketir levona lemachar –

a: Piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.

Ze hakkelal: kol hakkometz [o] noten bichli, hammolich, hammaktir, leechol davar sheddarko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir, chutz limkomo – pasul veen bo karet, chutz lizmanno – piggul vechayyayvin alav karet, uvilvad sheyyakriv hammattir kemitzvato.

Ketzad karev hammattir kemitzvato? kamatz bishtika, natan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz lizmanno; o shekkamatz chutz lizmanno, natan bichli veholich vehiktir bishtika; o shekkamatz venatan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz lizmanno – zehu shekkarev hammattir kemitzvato.

Ketzad lo karav hammattir kemitzvato? kamatz chutz limkomo, natan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz lizmanno, o shekkamatz chutz lizmanno, natan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz limkomo, o shekkamatz, natan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz limkomo – zehu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato.

Minchat chote uminchat kenaot shekkematzan shello lishman, natan bichli veholich vehiktir chutz lizmanno; o shekkamatz chutz lizmanno, natan bichli veholich vehiktir shello lishman; o shekkamatz venatan bichli veholich vehiktir shello lishman – zehu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato.
Leechol kezayit bachutz kezayit lemachar, kezayit lemachar kezayit bachutz, kachatzi zayit bachutz kachatzi zayit lemachar, kachatzi zayit lemachar kachatzi zayit bachutz – pasul veen bo karet.

Amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal: im machshevet hazzeman kadma lemachshevet hammakom – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet. im machshevet hammakom kadma lemachshevet hazzeman – pasul, veen bo karet. vachachamim omrim: ze vaze pasul veen bo karet.
Gemara ibbaya lehu, ledivre haomer: shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaketara maktir kometz alehen, vekayyma lan deotan shirayim asurim baachila, mahu detihanne lehu haketara lemikbeinhu befiggul?
(Velappekinhu) [uleappokinhu] mide meila?
Amar rav huna: afillu lerabbi akiva deamar "zerika moelet layyotze", hane mille yotze,
Deiteh beeneh, ufasul mechamat davar acher hu, aval chesron, difsula degufeh hu – la mahneya leh haketara.
Amar leh rava: adderabba, afillu lerabbi eliezer deamar "en zerika moelet layyotze" – hane mille yotze, deleteh bifnim, aval chesron deiteh bifnim – mahneya leh haketara.
Amar rava: mena amena la, ditnan: hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha bachutz o kezayit mishsheyareha bachutz, vetane rabbi chiyyay: hakkometz et hammincha, vela tane "o kezayit".
May tama la tane "o kezayit"? lav kegon shechasru shirayim vekamu lehu akkezayit, vechevan divmattan keli, behilluch, uvehaktara la mittene leh
b: "O kezayit" ashshirayim, bikmitza name leechol shirayim la tane "o kezayit", vekatane sefa: piggul vechayyayvin alav karet, alma mahneya lehu haketara.

Amar leh abbaye: la, ha manni? rabbi elazar hi, ditnan: hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat nesachim, shehikriv meachat mehen kezayit bachutz – chayyayv, verabbi elazar poter ad sheyyakriv et kullo.
Kevan divhaktarat kemitza la mittene leh "o kezayit mikkumetzah bachutz", beshirayim name la mittene leh "o kezayit".

I rabbi elazar, hay "lehaketir kumetzah", "lehaketir kumetzah ulevonatah" mibbee leh! ditnan: hakkometz vehallevona shehikriv et echad mehen bachutz – chayyayv, verabbi elazar poter ad sheyyakriv et shenehem.
Lo nitzrecha ella lekometz deminchat chote.
Veikkefel tanna leashmoinan kometz deminchat chote? in. vechen ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi elazar: kometz deminchat chote hu, verabbi elazar hi.
Hadar amar rava: lav milleta hi daamari, detanya: "kodesh kadashim hu", sheim nifresa achat mehen – challoteha kullan pesulot.
Ha yatzat – hane deikka gavvavy kesherot, man shamat leh deamar: zerika moelet layyotze? rabbi akiva hi, vekaamar: nifresa – la.
Amar leh abbaye: mi katane ha yatzat? dilma ha nitmet – hanach kesherot.
May tama? dimratztze tzitz, aval yatzat – la, verabbi eliezer hi, deamar: en zerika moelet layyotze.

Uvedin hu deibbei leh lemitne name yatzat, vehay dekatane nifresa – ha ka mashma lan, daafillu nifresa, deiteh bifnim – la mahneya leh haketara. aval lerabbi akiva deamar: zerika moelet layyotze – afillu chesron name mahneya leh haketara.
Mishna leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit – kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin.
Gemara tama deleechol ulehaktir, ha leechol veleechol davar sheen darko leechol – mitztaref.
Vehakatane resha: leechol davar sheddarko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir – davar sheddarko leechol, in; sheen darko leechol, la. man tanna?
Amar rabbi yirmeya: ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi, deamar: mechashshevin meachilat adam lammizbeach, umeachilat mizbeach laadam.
Ditnan: hakkometz et hammincha leechol davar sheen darko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheen darko lehaketir – kasher, verabbi eliezer posel.
Abbaye amar: afillu tema rabbanan, la tema ha leechol veleechol davar sheen darko leechol, ella ema ha leechol veleechol davar sheddarko leechol.

Umay ka mashma lan? ha behedya katane la: leechol kezayit bachutz uchezayit lemachar, kezayit lemachar uchezayit bachutz, kachatzi zayit bachutz vechachatzi zayit lemachar, kachatzi zayit lemachar vechachatzi zayit bachutz – pasul veen bo karet.

a: Ha tu lema li? i leechol veleechol davar (sheen) [she]darko leechol ka mashma lan demitztaref, meresha desefa shamat minna, dekatane: kachatzi zayit bachutz kachatzi zayit lemachar pasul, ha kachatzi zayit lemachar vechachatzi zayit lemachar – piggul.
I leechol ulehaktir (dehi gufa ka mashma lan), middiyyuka deresha shamat minna.
Dehashta, ma leechol veleechol davar sheen darko leechol – amrat la mitztaref, leechol ulehaktir mibbaya?
In, leechol ulehaktir itztericha leh, salka datach amena: hatam hu dela ki orcheh kamchashshev.
Aval hacha, divhay ki orcheh kamchashshev, uvehay ki orcheh ka mechashshev, ema litztaref, ka mashma lan.
Hadaran alach kol hammenachot.

Mishna hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha o lehaketir kumetzah lemachar – mode rabbi yose baze shehu piggul vechayyayvin alav karet. lehaketir levonatah lemachar, rabbi yose omer: pasul veen bo karet, vachachamim omrim: piggul vechayyayvin alav karet.
Amru lo: ma (shinna) [shanat] zo min hazzevach? amar lahen: shehazzevach damo uvesaro veemurav echad, ulevona enah min hammincha.
Gemara lema li lemitne "mode rabbi yose bazo"?
Mishshum deka bae lemitne sefa, lehaketir levonatah lemachar, rabbi yose omer: pasul veen bo karet.
Mahu detema: tama derabbi yose mishshum dekasavar en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir, vaafillu resha name,
b: Ka mashma lan divha mode.
Lehaketir levonatah lemachar, rabbi yose omer: pasul veen bo karet. amar resh lakish: omer haya rabbi yose, en mattir mefaggel et hammattir.
Vechen atta omer bishne beziche levona shel lechem happanim, sheen mattir mefaggel et hammattir.
May "vechen atta omer"? mahu detema tama derabbi yose bilvona – mishshum delav mina demincha hi, aval bishne beziche levona, demina dahadade ninhu – ema mefaggeli ahadade, ka mashma lan.

Umi matzet amrat tama derabbi yose bilvona lav mishshum delav mina demincha hi? veha katane sefa: amru lo: ma shinneta min hazzevach? amar lahen: hazzevach damo uvesaro veemurav echad, ulevona enah min hammincha.

May "enah min hammincha"? enah beikkuv mincha, delav ki hechi dimakkev lehu kometz leshirayim, dechamma delav mitkattar kometz la mitachli shirayim, hachi name meakkev la lilvona, ella i bae hay maktar beresha vei bae hay maktar beresha.

Verabbanan, ki amrinan "en mattir mefaggel et hammattir" (gabbe shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol mechavero lemachar, deamrat shenehem kesherim), hane mille hecha dela ikkevau bechad mana, aval hecha deikkevau bechad mana – kechad dame.
Amar rabbi yannay: likkut levona bezar – pasul. may tama? amar rabbi yirmeya: mishshum holacha nagu bah, kasavar holacha shello baregel shemah holacha, veholacha bezar – pesula.
Amar rav mari: af anan name tenena, ze hakkelal: kol hakkometz, venoten bichli, vehammolich, vehammaktir.
Bishlama kometz hayeynu shochet, molich name hayeynu molich, maktir hayeynu zorek, ella noten bichli may ka aved?
Illema mishshum dedame lekabbala, mi dame? hatam mimmela, hacha ka shakel verame.

Ella mishshum dechevan dela saggi leh dela aved la, avoda chashuva hi, al kurchaych meshavve la kekabbala. hacha name, kevan dela saggi le dela aved la, avoda chashuva hi, al kurchaych meshavve la ki holacha.
La, leolam dedame lekabbala, udeka kashya lach: hatam mimmela, hacha ka shakel verame –
Mikkede tarvayyhu kedushshat keli hu, ma li mimmela, ma li ka shakel verame.

Mishna shachat shene kevasim leechol achat min hachallot lemachar, hiktir shene bazichin leechol echad min hassedarim lemachar, rabbi yose omer: otah hachalla veoto hasseder shechishshev alav – piggul vechayyayvin alav karet, vehashsheni pasul veen bo karet. vachachamim omrim: ze vaze piggul vechayyayvin alav karet.
Gemara amar rav huna: omer haya rabbi yose, piggel bayyarech shel yamin – lo nitpaggel hayyarech shel semol. may tama? ibbaet ema sevara, veibbaet ema kera.
Ibbaet ema sevara: la adifa machshava mimmaase hattumea, illu ittammi chad ever mi ittammi leh kulleh? veibbaet ema kera: "vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu avonah tissa" – mimmennu velo mechavero.
Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna: vachachamim omrim, leolam en bo karet ad sheyyefaggel bishtehen bichzayit. bishtehen – in, beachat mehen – la.
Manni? illema rabbanan – afillu beachat mehen name! ella peshita rabbi yose. i amrat bishlama chad gufa hu – mishshum hachi mitztaref,

a: Ella i amrat tere gufe ninhu – mi mitztarfi?
Ha manni? rabbi hi, detanya: hashshochet et hakkeves leechol chatzi zayit mechalla zo, vechen chavero leechol chatzi zayit mechalla zo, rabbi omer: omer ani shezze kasher.
Tama deamar "chatzi chatzi", aval amar "kezayit mishshetehen" – mitztaref.
Verabbi, allibba deman? i allibba derabbanan – afillu beachat mehen name! i allibba derabbi yose – hadar kusheyayn leducheteh.
Leolam allibba derabbanan, vela tema "ad sheyyefaggel bishtehen", ella [ema] "ad sheyyefaggel bishnehen", vaafillu beachat mehen.
Uleappoke midderabbi meir, deamar: mefaggelin bachatzi mattir, ka mashma lan dela.
I hachi, may "leolam"? i amrat bishlama bishtehen uvishnehen, verabbi yose hi, uleappoke midderabbi meir umidderabbanan kaate – hayeynu dekaamar "leolam".
Ella i amrat rabbanan, uleappoke midderabbi meir, may "leolam"?
Veod, ha amar rav ashe: ta shema, rabbi omer mishshum rabbi yose: piggel bedavar hannaase bachutz – piggel, bedavar hannaase bifnim – lo piggel.

Ketzad? haya omed bachutz veamar: "hareni shochet al menat lehazzot middamo lemachar" – lo piggel, shemmachshava bachutz bedavar hannaase befanim. haya omed bifnim veamar: "hareni mazze al menat lehaketir emurin lemachar velishpoch shirayim lemachar" – lo piggel, shemmachshava bifnim bedavar hannaase bachutz.
Haya omed bachutz, veamar: "hareni shochet al menat lishpoch shirayim lemachar ulehaktir emurin lemachar" – piggel, shemmachshava bachutz bedavar hannaase bachutz.

Lishpoch shirayim, leippaggole may? ilema leippaggole dam – dam mi mippaggal? vehatnan: ellu devarim sheen chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul: hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat nesachim, uminchat kohen mashiach, vehaddam!

Ella peshita leippaggole basar, hasheta uma hatam dela chashshev beh bevasar gufeh, amar rabbi yose mippaggal, hacha dechashshev beh bezevach gufeh, lo kol shekken defiggel beyerech yamin piggel beyerech semol?
Veod, haamar ravina: ta shema, hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha o lehaketir kumetzah lemachar, mode rabbi yose bazo sheppiggel vechayyayvin alav karet.

Lehaketir kumetzah, leippaggole may? ilema leippaggole kometz, kometz mi mippaggal? vehatnan: ellu devarim sheen chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul: hakkometz kulei! ella peshita leippaggole shirayim. hasheta uma hatam, dela chashshev behu beshirayim gufeh,
b: Mippaggeli – hacha dechashshev behu bizvicha gufa, lo kol shekken?

Ella amar rabbi yochanan: hayeynu tama derabbi yose – hakkatuv asaan guf echad, vehakkatuv asaan shene gufin; guf echad – dimakkevi ahadade, shene gufin – deamar rachamana: ha lechoda avida veha lechoda avida.
Arvinhu – mitarvin, dehakkatuv asaan guf echad; palginhu mippalgi, dehakkatuv asaan shene gufin.
Bae rabbi yochanan: piggel belachme toda mahu, beminchat maafe mahu? tena leh rav tachlifa mimmareva: vechen atta omer belachme toda, vechen atta omer beminchat maafe.
Tanu rabbanan: bishat shechita chishshev leechol chatzi zayit, uvishat zerika chishshev leechol chatzi zayit – piggul, mippene sheshshechita uzerika mitztarfin.
Ikka deamri: shechita uzerika, detarvavyyhu mattirin – in, kabbala veholacha – la. veikka deamri: hanach dimrachakan, vechol shekken hane dimkarvan.
Ini? veha tane levi: arba avodot en mitztarfot lefiggul, shechita uzerika, kabbala veholacha! amar rava, la kashya: ha rabbi, ha rabbanan.
Detanya: hashshochet et hakkeves leechol chatzi zayit mechalla zo, vechen chavero leechol chatzi zayit mechalla zo, rabbi omer: omer ani shezze kasher.
Amar leh abbaye: emar deshamat leh lerabbi – chatzi mattir vachatzi achila, kullo mattir vachatzi achila mi shamat leh?
Amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye: vei it leh lerabbi kullo mattir vachatzi achila, ligzor chatzi mattir vachatzi achila attu kullo mattir vachatzi achila, deha rabbi yose gazar verabbanan gazri!
Rabbi yose gazar, ditnan: lehaketir levonatah lemachar, rabbi yose omer: pasul veen bo karet, vachachamim omrim: piggul vechayyayvin aleha karet.

Verabbanan name gazri, ditnan: piggel bakkometz velo ballevona, ballevona velo bakkometz – rabbi meir omer: piggul vechayyayvin alav karet, vachachamim omrim: en bo karet ad sheyyefaggel bechol hammattir.
Amar leh: hachi hasheta? bishlama hatam, gazar rabbi yose kometz dilvona attu kometz demincha.
Rabbanan gazri kometz attu kometz deminchat chote, ulevona attu levona habbaa bevazichin.
Kevasim name, keves attu keves chavero.
Bazech, attu bazech chavero.
Ella hacha, mi ikka chatzi mattir vachatzi achila bealma, delekum veligzar?

Hachi name mistabbera, detama derabbanan mishshum hachi hu, dekatane sefa: modim chachamim lerabbi meir beminchat chote uminchat kenaot sheim piggel bakkometz sheppiggul, vechayyayvin aleha karet, shehakkometz hu hammattir.
Ha lema li lemitna kelal? peshita, mi ikka mattir acharina? ella lav ha ka mashma lan, detama dekometz mishshum deikka kometz deminchat chote dedame leh.
Mishna nitmet achat min hachallot, o echad min hassedarim – rabbi yehuda omer: shenehem yetzu levet hasserefa, sheen korban tzibbur chaluk. vachachamim omrim: hattame betumeato vehattahor yeachel.
Gemara amar rabbi elazar: machloket lifne zerika, aval leachar zerika – divre hakkol hattame betumeato vehattahor yeachel.
Velifne zerika, bemay peligi? amar rav pappa: betzitz meratztze al achilot ka mippalgi,

a: Rabbanan savri: hatztzitz meratztze al achilot, verabbi yehuda savar: en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa: veha olin, dehatztzitz meratztze al haolin, ufeligi!
Detanya: nitma echad min habbazichin, rabbi yehuda omer: shenehem yeasu betumea, lefi sheen korban tzibbur chaluk, vachachamim omrim: hattame betumeato vehattahor betohorato.

Veod, amar rav ashe: ta shema, rabbi yehuda omer: afillu shevet echad tame vechol hashshevatim tehorin – yaasu betumea, lefi sheen (korbenot) [korban] tzibbur chaluk, vehacha may hatztzitz meratztze ikka?

Veod, haamar ravina: ta shema, nitmet achat min hachallot o (achat) [echad] min hassedarin, rabbi yehuda omer: shenehem yetzu levet hasserefa, lefi sheen korban tzibbur chaluk, vachachamim omrim: hattame betumeato vehattahor yeachel.
Veim ita, lefi sheen hatztzitz meratztze al achilot mibbee leh! ella amar rabbi yochanan: talmud aruch hu befiv shel rabbi yehuda, sheen korban tzibbur chaluk.

Mishna hattoda mefaggelet et hallechem, vehallechem eno mefaggel et hattoda. ketzad? shachat et hattoda leechol mimmenna lemachar – hi vehallechem mefuggalin, leechol min hallechem lemachar – hallechem mefuggal vehattoda enah mefuggelet.

Hakkevasim mefaggelin et hallechem, vehallechem eno mefaggel et hakkevasim. ketzad? hashshochet et hakkevasim leechol mehen lemachar – hem vehallechem mefuggalin, leechol et hallechem lemachar – hallechem mefuggal vehakkevasim enan mefuggalin.
Gemara may tama? illema mishshum derav kahana, deamar rav kahana: minnayin lelachme toda shennikreu toda? shenneemar: "vehikriv al zevach hattoda challot".
I hachi ippecha name, ha la kashya: lechem ikkeri toda, toda la ikkeri lechem.

Ella ha dekatane: hakkevasim mefaggelin et hallechem vehallechem eno mefaggel et hakkevasim, lechem hecha ashkechan deikkeri kevasim? ella lav hayeynu tama: lechem gelal toda, veen toda gelal (delechem) [lechem], lechem gelal (dichvasim) [chevasim], veen kevasim gelal (delechem) [lechem].

Utzerichi, dei ashmeinan toda – hatam hu dechi mefaggel belechem la mippaggela toda, mishshum dela huzekku ze laze bitnufa, aval kevasim dehuzekku ze laze bitnufa – ema ki mefaggel belechem lippaggeli name kevasim, tzericha.

Bea minneh rabbi elazar merav: hashshochet et hattoda leechol kezayit mimmenna umillachmah lemachar, mahu leippaggole? toda la mibbaya li, hasheta kullo millachmah la mippaggela, mimmenna umillachmah mibbaya?
Ki ka mibbaya li leippaggole lechem, mi mitztarfa toda leippaggole lelechem o la?
Amar leh: af bezo, hallechem mefuggal vehattoda enah mefuggelet. veammay? lema kal vachomer: uma toda hamefaggel en mitpaggel, habba lefaggel velo piggel – eno din shello yitpaggel?
Umi amrinan kal vachomer ki hay gavvna? vehatanya: maase beechad
b: Shezzara karmo shel chavero semadar, uva maase lifne chachamim, veasru et hazzeraim vehittiru et haggefanim. veammay? lema kal vachomer hu: uma haoser eno neesar, habba leesor velo asar – eno din shello yitasser?

Hachi hasheta? hatam kanbos veluf asra tora, ditnan: hayta sadehu zerua kanbos velof lo yehe zorea al gabbehem, shehen osot leshalosh shanim – shear zeraim midderabbanan hu daasiri. hay deaved issura – kansu rabbanan, hay dela aved issura – la kansu rabbanan. aval hacha, lema kal vachomer!
Veikka dematne la akkevasim, bea minneh rabbi elazar merav: hashshochet et hakkevasim leechol kezayit mehen umillachman, mahu?
Leippaggole kevasim la ka mibbaya li, hasheta kullo millechem la mippaggeli, mehen umillachman mibbaya? ki ka mibbaya li leippaggole lechem, mi mitztarfi kevasim leippaggole lelechem o la?
Amar leh: af bezo, hallechem mefuggal vehakkevasim enan mefuggalin. veammay? lema kal vachomer: uma hamefaggel eno mitpaggel, habba lefaggel velo piggel – eno din shello yitpaggel?

Umi amrinan kal vachomer ki hay gavna? vehatanya: maase beechad shezzara karmo shel chavero semadar vechulei. veammay? lema kal vachomer: ma haoser eno neesar, habba leesor vela asar – eno din shello yitasser?
Hachi hasheta? hatam kanbos valuf asra tora, shear zeraim midderabbanan hu daasiri, hay deaved issura – kansu rabbanan, dela aved issura – la kansu rabbanan, aval hacha lema kal vachomer!
Man dematne la attoda – kol shekken akkevasim, uman dematne la akkevasim – kevasim hu dehuzekku ze laze litnufa, aval toda delo huzekka ze laze bitnufa – la.

Rabbi abba zute bae la hachi, bea minneh rabbi elazar merav: hashshochet et hakkeves leechol kezayit mechavero lemachar, mahu? "chavero" keves mashma, vela mefaggel, o dilma "lechem" mashma, umefaggel leh.

Amar leh: tenetuha, shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol mimmennu lemachar – hu piggul vachavero kasher, leechol mechavero lemachar – shenehem kesherim, alma "chavero" keves mashma! dilma defaresh veamar "chavero keves".

Mishna hazzevach mefaggel et hannesachim, mishshekkadshu bichli, divre rabbi meir. hannesachim enan mefaggelim et hazzevach. ketzad? hashshochet et hazzevach leechol mimmennu lemachar – hu unesachav mefuggalin, lehakeriv nesachav lemachar – hannesachim mefuggalin, hazzevach eno mefuggal.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: nische behema chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul, mippene sheddam hazzevach mattiran likrav, divre rabbi meir.
Amru lo lerabbi meir: vahalo adam mevi zivcho hayyom unesachav ad asara yamim! amar lahen: af ani lo amarti ella bevain im hazzevach. amru lo: efshar leshannoto lezevach acher!
Amar rava: kasavar rabbi meir, hukebu bishchita, kelachme toda.

Tanu rabbanan: log shemen shel metzora chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, mippene sheddam asham mattiro labbehonot, divre rabbi meir. amru lo lerabbi meir: vahalo adam mevi ashamo hayyom, veluggo mikkan vead asara yamim.
Amar lahen: af ani lo amarti ella beva im haasham. efshar leshannoto leasham acher. amar rava: kasavar rabbi meir hukebu bishchita, kelachme toda.

a: Mishna piggel bakkometz velo ballevona, ballevona velo bakkometz – rabbi meir omer: piggul vechayyayvin alav karet, vachachamim omrim: en bo karet ad sheyyefaggel bechol hammattir.
Umodim chachamim lerabbi meir beminchat chote uveminchat kenaot, sheim piggel bakkometz, shehu piggul vechayyayvin alav karet, shehakkometz hu hammattir.

Shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol shete challot lemachar, hiktir echad min habbazichin leechol shene sedarim lemachar – rabbi meir omer: piggul vechayyayvin alav karet, vachachamim omrim: en bo karet ad sheyyefaggel bechol hammattir.
Shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol mimmennu lemachar – hu piggul, vachavero kasher; leechol mechavero lemachar – shenehem kesherim.
Gemara amar rav: machloket shennatan et hakkometz bishtika, veet hallevona bemachshava.
Aval natan hakkometz bemachshava, veet hallevona bishtika – divre hakkol piggul, shekkol haose al daat rishona hu ose. ushemuel amar: adayin hiv machloket.
Yatev rava vekaamar la leha shemata, etiveh rav acha bar rav huna lerava: bamme devarim amurim – bikmitza, uvemattan keli, uvehilluch.

Ba lo lehaketara, natan et hakkometz bishtika veet hallevona bemachshava, et hakkometz bemachshava veet hallevona bishtika – rabbi meir omer: piggul vechayyayvin alav karet, vachachamim omrim: en bo karet ad sheyyefaggel bechol hammattir.
Katane miha: natan et hakkometz bemachshava veet hallevona bishtika, ufeligi.
Ema: uchevar natan et hallevona bishtika meikkara. shete teshuvot baddavar: chada, dehayynu kammayyta, veod, hatanya: achar kach.
Targema rav chanina bishte deot.
Ta shema: bamme devarim amurim? bedamim hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon.

Aval damim hannittanin al mizbeach happenimi, kegon arbaim veshalosh shel yom hakkippurim, veachat esre shel par kohen mashuach, veachat esre shel par helem davar shel tzibbur, piggel ben barishona ben bashsheniyya uven bashshelishit, rabbi meir omer: piggul vechayyayvin alav karet, vachachamim omrim: en bo karet ad sheyyefaggel bechol hammattir.
Katane miha: piggel ben barishona, ben bashsheniyya, uven bashshelishit, ufeligi.
Vechi tema, hacha name bishte deot – hanicha leman deamar "befar" vaafillu bedamo shel par, ella leman deamar "befar" velo bedamo shel par, may ikka lememar?

Amar rava: hacha bemay askinan? kegon sheppiggel barishona, veshatak bashsheniyya, ufiggel bashshelishit, deamrinan: i salka datach kol haose al daat rishona hu ose, mihdar paygole bashshelishit lema li?

Matkef la rav ashe: midde shatak katane? ella amar rav ashe: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheppiggel barishona uvashsheniyya uvashshelishit, deamrinan: i salka datach kol haose al daat rishona hu ose, mihdar paggole bashsheniyya uvashshelishit lema li?
b: Veha "ben ben" katane! kashya.
Amar mar: rabbi meir omer piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet. mikkede, karet la michayyayv ad sheyyikrevu kol hammattirin.
Deamar mar: "yeratze" – keharetzaat kasher, kach haretzaat pasul; ma haretzaat kasher ad sheyyikrevu kol hammattirin, af haretzaat pasul ad sheyyikrevu kol hammattirin.
Vehay, kevan dechashshev be bifnim – pasleh, ki madde behechal – mayya bealma hu deka madde.
Amar rabba: mashkachat la bearbaa parim vearbaa seirim.
Rava amar: afillu tema par echad vesair echad, lefaggole meratztze.
Arbaim veshalosh, vehatanya: arbaim vasheva! la kashya, ha keman deamar: mearvin likranot, veha keman deamar: en mearvin.
Vehatanya: arbaim ushemona! la kashya, ha keman deamar: shirayim meakkevin, ha keman deamar: shirayim lo meakkevin.
Ibbaya lehu: piggel beholacha, mahu?
Amar rabbi yochanan: holacha kikmitza, veresh lakish amar: holacha kehaketara.
Bishlama leresh lakish, ikka name holacha dilvona, ella lerabbi yochanan may tama?
Amar rava, kasavar rabbi yochanan: kol avoda sheenah matteret, avoda chashuva hi lefaggel aleha bifne atzmah.
Amar leh abbaye: hare shechitat echad min hakkevasim, daavoda sheenah mattiratah, ufeligi.

Ditnan: shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol shete challot lemachar, hiktir echad min habbazichin leechol shene sedarim lemachar, rabbi meir omer: piggul vechayyayvin alav karet, vachachamim omrim: en bo karet ad sheyyefaggel bechol hammattir.
Amar leh: mi savrat lechem betannur kadosh? shechitat kevasim mekaddesha leh, vehabba lekaddesh keva lehattir dame.
Metiv rav shimi bar ashe: acherim omrim: hikdim mulim laarelim – kasher, hikdim arelim lemulim – pasul.
Vekayyma lan, devachatzi mattir peligi. amar leh: mi savrat dam betzavvar behema kadosh? dam – sakkin mekaddesha leh, vehabba lekaddesh keva lehattir dame.
Ta shema: bamme devarim amurim – bikmitza, uvemattan keli, uvehilluch.
May lav hilluch dehaktara? la, hilluch demattan keli.
I hachi, bemattan keli uvehilluch? behilluch uvemattan keli mibbee leh! ha la kashya, tane hachi.
Ba lo lehaketara? ba lo leholacha mibbee leh! ha la kashya, kevan deholacha tzorech dehaktara hi, kare la haketara.
Ella, natan et hakkometz bishtika – holich mibbee leh! kashya.
Hiktir shumeshum leechol shumeshum, ad shekkala kometz kullo – rav chisda verav hamenuna verav sheshet: chad amar: piggul, vechad amar: pasul, vechad amar: kasher.
Lema: man deamar piggul – kerabbi meir, uman deamar pasul – kerabbanan, uman deamar kasher – kerabbi.
Mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam, ella dechishshev beshiuro, aval hacha delo chishshev beshiuro – la.
Vead kan la ka amri rabbanan hatam, ella dela chashshev beh bechulleh mattir, aval hacha dechashshev beh bechulleh mattir – hachi name defaggel.
Vead kan la ka amar rabbi hatam, ella dela hadar malleyeh meotah avoda, aval hacha dahadar malleyeh meotah avoda – hachi name defasel.
Ella, man deamar piggul – divre hakkol, man deamar pasul – divre hakkol, man deamar kasher – divre hakkol.

Man deamar piggul divre hakkol, kasavar: derech achila bechach, vederech haketara bechach. uman deamar pasul divre hakkol, kasavar: en derech achila bechach, veen derech haketara bechach, vehavya lah kemincha shello huketra. uman deamar kasher divre hakkol, kasavar: derech haketara bechach, veen derech achila bechach.
Amri

a: Charife defumebdita: haketara mefaggelet haketara, vaafillu lerabbanan deamri en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir – hane mille hecha dechashshev beh beshirayim ulevona bemilleta kayyma, aval hacha dechashshev la bilvona – kema dechashshev beh bechulleh mattir dame.

Amar rava: af anan name tenena, ze hakkelal: kol hakkometz venoten bichli, vehammolich vehammaktir, leechol davar sheddarko leechol ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir, chutz limkomo – pasul veen bo karet, chutz lizmanno – piggul vechayyayvin alav karet.
May lav haketara dumeya dehanach, ma hanach – ben leechol ben lehaketir, af haketara – ben leechol ben lehaketir?
La, hanach – ben leechol ben lehaketir; haketara – leechol in, lehaketir la.
Yatev rav menashsheya bar gadda kammeh deabbaye, veyatev veka amar mishshemeh derav chisda: en haketara mefaggelet haketara, vaafillu lerabbi meir, deamar: "mefaggelin bachatzi mattir" –
Hane mille hecha dechashshev behu beshirayim, dekometz mattir didhu, aval hacha dekometz lav mattir dilvona hu – la matze mefaggel beh.
Amar leh abbaye: ani mari mishshemeh derav? amar leh: in. ittemar name, amar rav chisda amar rav: en haketara mefaggelet haketara.

Amar rav yaakov bar idi mishshemeh deabbaye: af anan name tenena, shachat echad min hakkevasim leechol mimmennu lemachar – hu piggul vachavero kasher, leechol mechavero lemachar – shenehem kesherin. may tama? lav mishshum dechevan delav mattir dideh hu, la matze mefaggel beh.
La, hatam hu dela ikkeva bechad mana, aval hacha deikkeva bechad mana – ki chad damu.
Amar rav hamenuna: ha milleta avla li rabbi chanina, utekila li kechulleh talmuday – hiktir kometz lehaketir levona, ulevona leechol shirayim lemachar – piggul.

May ka mashma lan? i haketara mefaggelet haketara ka mashma lan – lema: "hiktir kometz lehaketir levona"! i mefaggelin bachatzi mattir ka mashma lan – lema: "hiktir kometz leechol shirayim lemachar"! i tarvayyhu ata ka mashma lan – lema: "hiktir kometz lehaketir levona veleechol shirayim lemachar"!
Amar rav adda bar ahava: leolam kasavar en haketara mefaggelet haketara, veen mefaggelin bachatzi mattir, veshane hacha defashta lay machshava bechulla mincha.
Tane tanna kammeh derav yitzchak bar abba: hiktir kometz leechol shirayim – ledivre hakkol piggul. veha miflag peligi? ella ema: ledivre hakkol pasul.
Velema: hare ze piggul, verabbi meir hi! tanna "divre hakkol" atneyu, "piggul" befasul" michallaf leh, "hare ze" bedivre hakkol" la michallaf leh.
Hadaran alach hakkometz et hammincha.
Mishna hakkometz et hammincha leechol davar sheen darko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheen darko lehaketir – kasher, rabbi eliezer posel.
Leechol davar sheddarko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir pachot mikkezayit – kasher. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit – kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin.

Gemara amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi eliezer? amar kera "veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav" – bishte achilot hakkatuv medabber, echad achilat adam veechad achilat mizbeach, lomar lach: keshem shemmechashshevin baachilat adam, kach mechashshevin baachilat mizbeach.
Ucheshem shemmechashshevin meachilat adam laachilat adam, umeachilat mizbeach laachilat mizbeach, kach mechashshevin meachilat adam lammizbeach, umeachilat mizbeach laadam.
May tama? middeappekinhu rachamana lehaketara bilshon achila.
Verabbanan, hay deappekinhu rachamana bilshon achila,
b: Dela shena ki mechashshev bilshon achila lemizbeach, vela shena ki mechashshev bilshon haketara lammizbeach.
I name, ma achila bichzayit – af haketara bichzayit, uleolam achila deorcha mashma.
Verabbi eliezer, im ken, lichtov rachamana "im heachol heachol", i name "im yeachel yeachel", may "heachol yeachel"? shamat minna tarte.

Amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi: vei tama derabbi eliezer mishshum hachi hu, karet name lichayyayv? vechi tema hachi name, veha at hu deamrat mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: mode rabbi eliezer sheen anush karet!
Amar leh: tannae hi allibba derabbi eliezer, ikka leman deamar: pesula deorayyta, veikka leman deamar: pesula derabbanan.

Detanya: hashshochet et hazzevach lishtot middamo lemachar, lehaketir mibbesaro lemachar, leechol meemurav lemachar – kasher, verabbi eliezer posel. lehanniach middamo lemachar – rabbi yehuda posel. amar rabbi elazar: af bazo rabbi eliezer posel vachachamim machshirin.
Rabbi yehuda, allibba deman? ilema allibba derabbanan – hasheta, uma hatam deka mechashshev bilshon achila machsheri rabbanan, hacha lo kol shekken?
Ella, allibba derabbi eliezer, veamar rabbi elazar: af bezo rabbi eliezer posel vachachamim machshirin. rabbi elazar hayeynu rabbi yehuda!
Ella lav karet ikka benayyhu, derabbi yehuda (detanna kamma) savar: lehanniach – pesula bealma, behanach karet name michayyayv, vaata rabbi elazar lememar: idde veidde pasul veen bo karet!
La, dechulle alma karet lekka, vehacha shalosh machloket bedavar: tanna kamma savar behanach peligi, lehanniach – divre hakkol kasher,

a: Verabbi yehuda savar behanach peligi, lehanniach – divre hakkol pasul. may tama? gezera miktzat damo attu kol damo, vechol damo pesula deorayyta.
Detanya, amar lahem rabbi yehuda: i attem modim li sheim hinnicho lemachar sheppasul? chishshev lehannicho lemachar name pasul.
Vaata rabbi elazar lememer: af bezo rabbi eliezer posel vachachamim machshirin.
