Vesavar rabbi yehuda lehanniach middamo lemachar divre hakkol pasul? vehatanya: amar rabbi: keshehalachti lematztzot middotay etzel rabbi elazar ben shammua, veamri la lematztzot middotav shel rabbi elazar ben shammua, matzati yosef habbavli yoshev lefanav, vehaya chaviv lo beyoter, ad leachat amar lo: rabbi, hashshochet et hazzevach lehanniach middamo lemachar mahu?
Amar lo: kasher. arvit amar lo: kasher. shacharit amar lo: kasher. tzohorayim amar lo: kasher. mincha amar lo: kasher, ella sherabbi eliezer posel. tzahavu panav shel yosef habbavli.

Amar lo: yosef, kimdumme ani shello kivvavnnu shemuatenu ad atta. amar lo: rabbi, hen! ella sherabbi yehuda pasul shana li, vechazarti al kol talmidav uvikkashti li chaver velo matzati, achshav sheshshanita li pasul – hechzarta li avedati.

Zalgu enav demaot shel rabbi elazar ben shammua, amar: ashrechem talmide chachamim sheddivre tora chavivin alechem beyoter, kara alav hammikra hazze: "ma ahavti toratecha kol hayyom hi sichati vegomer", ha mippene sherabbi yehuda beno shel rabbi ilay, verabbi ilay talmido shel rabbi eliezer, lefichach shana lecha mishnat rabbi eliezer.
Vei salka datach divre hakkol pasul atneyeh, may hechzarta li avedati? ihu pelugeta kaamar leh.
Ella may, kasher verabbi eliezer (pasul) posel atneyeh? i hachi, may ha mippene pelugeta? anan name pelugeta ka matninan!
Ella, leolam "divre hakkol pasul" atneyeh, umay hechzarta li avedati? (dahadar) [deahdar] leh miha shum paslut baolam.
Mishna lo yatzak, lo balal, velo patat, velo melach, velo henif, lo higgish, o sheppetatan pittim merubbot, velo meshachan – keshera.
Gemara may "lo yatzak"? illema lo yatzak kelal – ikkuva ketav bah! ella, lo yatzak kohen, ella zar. i hachi, "lo balal" name – lo balal kohen, ella zar, ha lo balal kelal – pesula.
b: Vehatnan: shishshim nivlalin, shishshim veechad en nivlalin, vehavenan bah: ki enam nivlalin may have? vehatnan: "lo balal" – keshera!
Veamar rabbi zera: kol harauy levilla – en billa meakkevet bo, vechol sheeno rauy levilla – billa meakkevet bo.
Midde irya? ha kidita veha kidita: "lo yatzak" – lo yatzak kohen ella zar, "lo balal" – lo balal kelal.
O sheppetatan pittim merubbot – keshera. hasheta lo patat kelal – keshera, pittin merubbot mibbaya? may "pittin merubbot"? sheribba biftitin.
Veibbaet ema: leolam pittim merubbot mammash, umahu detema: hatam hu deikka torat challot alehen, aval hacha, dela torat challot ikka vela torat petitin ikka, ka mashma lan.

Lema matnitin dela kerabbi shimon, detanya: rabbi shimon omer: kol kohen sheeno mode baavoda en lo chelek bakkehunna, shenneemar: "hammakriv et dam hashshelamim veet hachelev mibbene aharon lo tihye shok hayyamin lemana" – mode baavoda yesh lo chelek bakkehunna, sheeno mode baavoda en lo chelek bakkehunna.
Veen li ella zo bilvad, minnayin lerabbot chamesh esre avodot –

Hayyetzikot, vehabbelilot, vehappetitot, vehammelichot, vehattenufot, vehahaggashot, vehakkemitzot, vehaketarot, vehammelikot, vehakkabbalot, vehazzaot, vehashekaat sota, vaarifat egla, vetohorat metzora, unesiut kappayim, ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, minnayin?
Talmud lomar: "mibbene aharon", avoda hammesura livne aharon, kol kohen sheeno mode bah en lo chelek bakkehunna!

Amar rav nachman, la kashya: kan beminchat kohanim, kan beminchat yisrael. minchat yisrael devat kemitza hi, mikkemitza veelach mitzvat kehunna, limmed al yetzika uvelila shekkeshera bezar. minchat kohanim delav bat kemitza hi, meikkara baaya kehunna.
Amar leh rava: mikkede minchat kohanim mehecha itrabbay litzika? mimminchat yisrael, ma hatam keshera bezar – af hacha name keshera bezar!
Ikka deamri, amar rav nachman: la kashya, kan benikmatzot, kan besheen nikmatzot.
Amar leh rava: mikkede sheen nikmatzot, mehecha itrabbay litzika? minnikmatzot, kenikmatzot – ma hatam keshera bezar, af hacha name keshera bezar! ella mechavvavrta matnitin dela kerabbi shimon.

May tama derabbanan? amar kera: "veyatzak aleha shemen venatan aleha levona veheviah el bene aharon hakkohen vekamatz", mikkemitza veelach mitzvat kehunna, limmed al yetzika uvelila shekkeshera bezar.
Verabbi shimon, "bene aharon

a: Hakkohanim" – mikra nidrash lefanav uleacharav.

Vesavar rabbi shimon mikra nidrash lefanav uleacharav? vehatanya: "velakach hakkohen middam hachattat beetzbao venatan al karnot hammizbeach", "beetzbao velakach" – melammed shello tehe kabbala ella beyamin, "beetzbao venatan" – melammed shello tehe netina ella beyamin.
Amar rabbi shimon: vechi neemar "yad" bekabbala? hoil velo neemar "yad" bekabbala, kibbel bismol – kasher.
Veamar abbaye: bemikra nidrash lefanav uleacharav ka mippalgi (verabbi shimon savar: leacharav nidrash, ulefanav en nidrash).
Ella hayeynu tama derabbi shimon: "veheviah" – vav mosif al inyan rishon.

Vesavar rabbi shimon vav mosif al inyan rishon? ella meatta, dichtiv: "veshachat et ben habbakar vehikrivu bene aharon hakkohanim et haddam vezarku et haddam", mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna, melammed al shechita shekkeshera bezar; i lerabbi shimon vav mosif al inyan rishon, shechita hachi name bezar tehe pesula!
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "vesamach ... veshachat", ma semicha bezarim – af shechita bezarim.
I: ma semicha bivalim, af shechita bivalim? hahu la matzet amarta, kal vachomer: uma zerika deikkar kappara – la baaya bealim, shechita delav ikkar kappara – lo kol shekken.
Vechi tema, en danin efshar mishshei efshar, galli rachamana beyom hakkippurim: "veshachat et par hachattat asher lo", mikkelal dishchita bealma la baenan bealim.
Amar rav: kol makom shenneemar "tora" vechukka", eno ella leakkev. ka salka datin tarte baaya, kedichtiv: "zot chukkat hattora".
Vahare nazir, dela ketiva beh ella tora, veamar rav: tenufa benazir meakkeva! shane hatam, kevan dichtiv "ken yaase", keman dichtiva behu chukka dame.
Hare toda, dela ketiva beh ella tora, utenan: arbaa shebbattoda meakkevin ze et ze. shane toda deittakkash lenazir, dichtiv: "al zevach todat shelamav", veamar mar: "shelamav" lerabbot shalme nazir.
Vahare metzora, dela ketiv beh ella tora, utenan: arbaa minin shebbammetzora meakkevin ze et ze! shane hatam, kevan dichtiv "zot tihye torat hammetzora", keman dichtiv beh chukka dame.
Vahare yom hakkippurim, dela ketiv beh ella chukka, utenan: shene seire yom hakkippurim meakkevin ze et ze, ella: o tora o chukka.
Vahare shear korbanot, dichtiv behu tora, vela meakkevi? tora baaya chukka, vechukka la baaya tora.
Veha tora vechukka ka amar, hachi kaamar: af al gav dichtiv tora, i ketiva chukka – in, vei la – la.
Vahare mincha, dichtiv bah chukka, veamar rav: kol makom shehechzir hakkatuv betorat mincha eno ella leakkev, hechzir – in, lo hechezir – la.
Shane hatam, dechi ketiva chukka – aachila ketiva.
Vahare lechem happanim, dechi ketiva chukka aachila ketiva, utenan: shene sedarim meakkevin ze et ze, shene bazichin meakkevin ze et ze, hassedarin vehabbazichin meakkevin ze et ze.
Ella, kol hecha dichtiva aachila – akkolla milleta ketiva.
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "miggirsah umishshamnah",
b: Geres vashemen meakkevin, veen davar acher meakkev.

Gufa, amar rav: kol makom shehechzir lecha hakkatuv battora mincha, eno ella leakkev. ushemuel amar: geres vashemen meakkevin, veen davar acher meakkev. velishmuel, af al gav ditna beh kera la meakkeva leh?
Ella, kol hecha ditna beh kera vadday meakkeva, vehacha bimlo kumetzo" "bekumetzo" ka mippalgi, detanya: "melo kumtzo" "bekumtzo" – shello yaase midda lakkometz.
Rav savar: ha name tena beh kera, dichtiv: "vayyakrev et hammincha vaymalle chappo mimmenna", ushemuel: dorot mishshaa la yalfinan.

Vela yalef shemuel dorot mishshaa? vehatnan: kele hallach mekaddeshin et hallach, umiddot yavesh mekaddeshin et hayyavesh, veen kele hallach mekaddeshin et hayyavesh, velo middot yavesh mekaddeshin et hallach.
Veamar shemuel: lo shanu ella middot, aval mizrakot mekaddeshin, dichtiv "shenehem meleim solet"!
Shane hatam, ditna bah kera teresar zimnin.
Amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: vahare haggasha, ditna bah kera, vela meakkeva! man tena beh? dichtiv: "zot torat hammincha hakerev otah bene aharon lifne Adonai"!
Hahu likboa lah makom hu daata, detanya: "lifne Adonai" – yachol bammaarav? talmud lomar: "el pene hammizbeach".
I "el pene hammizbeach" yachol baddarom, talmud lomar "lifne Adonai", ha ketzad? maggishah bekeren deromit maaravit keneged chuddah shel keren vedayyo.

Rabbi eliezer omer: yachol yaggishenna lemaaravah shel keren o lidromah shel keren? amarta: kol makom sheatta motze shete mikraot, echad mekayyem atzmo umekayyem chavero, veechad mekayyem atzmo umevattel et chavero – mannichin et shemmekayyem atzmo umevattel chavero, vetofsin et shemmekayyem atzmo umekayyem chavero.
Shekkesheatta omer "lifne Adonai" bammaarav, bittalta "el pene hammizbeach" baddarom, uchesheatta omer "el pene hammizbeach" baddarom, kiyyaymta "lifne Adonai".
Vehecha kiyyaymta? amar rav ashe: kasavar hay tanna kulleh mizbeach betzafon kae.
Matkef la rav huna: hare melach, dela tena beh kera, umeakkeva beh! detanya: "berit melach olam hiv" – shettehe

a: Berit amura bemelach, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: neemar kan "berit melach olam hiv", veneemar lehallan "berit kehunnat olam" – keshem shei efshar lekorbanot belo kehunna, kach i efshar lekorbanot belo melach.

Amar rav yosef: rav ketanna didan sevira leh, deamar: lo malach – kasher. amar leh abbaye: i hachi, lo yatzak name – lo yatzak kelal? ella: lo yatzak kohen ella zar, hacha name: lo malach kohen ella zar.
Amar leh: vechi taale al datecha shezzar karev legabbe mizbeach?
Vei baet ema, kevan dichtiva beh "berit", keman ditna beh kera damya.
Vela tena beh kera? vehachtiv: "vechol korban minchatcha bammelach timlach"! hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: illu neemar "korban bammelach", shomea ani afillu etzim vadam shennikreu korban.
Talmud lomar: "mincha", ma mincha meyuchedet sheacherim bain chova lah, af kol sheacherim bain chova lah.
I ma mincha meyuchedet shemmatteret, af kol shemmattir, avi dam shemmattir – talmud lomar "meal minchatecha", velo meal damecha.
Yachol tehe mincha kullah teuna melach? talmud lomar: "korban", korban taun melach, veen mincha kullah teuna melach.
Veen li ella kometz mincha, minnayin lerabbot et hallevona? merabbe ani et hallevona, shekken baa immah bichli echad.
Minnayin lerabbot et hallevona habbaa bifne atzmah, ulevona habbaa bevazichin, vehakketoret,
Minchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat nesachim, emure chattat, veemure asham, veemure kodshe kadashim, veemure kadashim kallim, veevre ola, veolat haof – minnayin?
Talmud lomar: "al kol korbancha takriv melach".
Amar mar: en li ella kometz (mincha), minnayin lerabbot et hallevona? merabbe ani et hallevona, shekken baa immah bichli echad. veha amrat: ma mincha meyuchedet sheacherim bain chova lah?
Hachi kaamar: ema "korban" – kalal, umincha" – parat, kelal uferat – en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat, mincha – in, midde acharina – la.
Hadar amar: "al kol korbancha", chazar vechalal, kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat, ma happerat meforash sheacherim bain chova lah, af kol sheacherim bain chova lah.
Acherim devain chova lah, may nihu – etzim, af kol etzim.
Ema (acherim devain chova lah nihu) – levona, veayyti dam, deikka nesachim! nesachim bahade emurin hu deatu, may tama? achila ushetiyya. adderabba – kappara vesimcha!
Ella, levona baa immah bichli echad, aval etzim, ki hechi demittachshera behu mincha, hachi (mittachshera) [mittachsheri] behu kullehu korbanot.
Veema: ma happerat meforash, sheacherim bain chova lah umatteret – af kol sheacherim bain chova lah umatteret, umay nihu? levona habbaa bevazichin, desharya lechem, aval midde acharina – la.
Middeitzterich "meal minchatecha" velo meal damecha, mikkelal dehanach kullehu atu bechad tzad.
Amar mar: "meal minchatecha" velo meal damecha, veema: "meal minchatecha" velo meal evarecha?
Mistabbera, evarim hava leh lerabboye, shekken (301 102 siman)
Acherim bain chova lah kemotah, ishshim kemotah, bachutz kemotah, notar kemotah,
Tumea kemotah, meila kemotah.
b: Adderabba: dam hava leh lerabboye, shekken mattir kemotah, nifsal bishkiat hachamma kemotah! hanach nefishan.
Amar mar: shomea ani afillu etzim vadam shennikreu korban. man shamat leh deamar etzim ikkero korban? rabbi! lerabbi mibbaya bau melach!

Detanya: "korban mincha" – melammed shemmitnaddevin etzim, vechamma? shene gezirin, vechen hu omer: "vehaggoralot hippalnu al kurban haetzim", rabbi amar: etzim korban mincha hen, uteunin melach, uteunin haggasha.
Veamar rava: ledivre rabbi, etzim teunin kemitza. veamar rav pappa: ledivre rabbi, etzim tzerichin etzim.
Semi mikkan etzim, veella kera lemaote may? i lemaote dam – meal minchatecha" nafka!

a: Appek etzim veayyel nesachim, detanya: aval hayyayin vehaddam vehaetzim vehakketoret en teunin melach.
Manni? i rabbi – kashya etzim, i rabbanan – kashya ketoret.

Hay tanna hu, detanya: rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: ma happerat meforash – davar shemmekabbel tumea, veole laishshim, veyeshno al mizbeach hachitzon, af kol davar hamekabbel tumea veole laishshim veyeshno al mizbeach hachitzon.
Yatzu etzim – sheen mekabbelin tumea, yatzu dam vayayin – sheen olim laishshim, yatza ketoret – sheenah al mizbeach hachitzon.

Ella tama demaateh kera ledam, ha lav hachi hava amena dam live melach? kevan demalcheh nafek leh mittorat dam, deamar zeeri amar rabbi chanina: dam shebbishshelo eno over alav, verav yehuda amar zeeri: dam shemmelacho eno over alav.
Verav yehuda dideh amar: evarim shetztzelaan veheelan, en bahem mishshum "lereach nichoach".
Mahu detema: mishde ba mashshehu lemitzva bealma – ka mashma lan.
Gufa, amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina: dam shebbishshelo eno over alav. yatev rava veka amar la leha shemata, etiveh abbaye: hikpa et haddam vaachalo, o shehimcha et hachelev ugemao – chayyayv.
La kashya, kan shehikpa baur, kan shehikpa bachamma. beur – la hadar, bachamma – hadar.
Bachamma name lema: hoil veiddechi iddechi, deha bea minneh rabbi mani merabbi yochanan: dam shekkarash vaachalo, mahu? amar leh: hoil venidcha yiddache. ishtik.
Amar leh: dilma vadday, kan bechattaot hachitzoniyyot, kan bechattaot happenimiyyot!

Amar, adkartan milleta deamar rav chisda: dam shekkarash bechattaot vaachalo – chayyayv, "velakach venatan" amar rachamana, bar lekicha unetina hu. bechattaot happenimiyyot vaachalo – patur, "vetaval vehizza" amar rachamana, vehay lav bar tevila vehazzaa hu.

Verava dideh amar: afillu bechattaot happenimiyyot vaachalo – chayyayv, hoil uchenegdo rauy bechattaot hachitzonot. amar rav pappa: hilkach dam chamor shekkarash vaachalo – chayyayv, hoil uchenegdo rauy bechattaot hachitzonot.

Amar rav giddel, amar zeeri: dam, ben lach ben yavesh, chotzetz. metivi: haddam vehaddeyo vehaddevash vehechalav, yeveshin – chotztzin, lachin – enan chotztzin. la kashya, ha desarech, ha dela sarech.
"Timlach", lemay ata? lechidtanya: "bammelach" – yachol tevonehu? talmud lomar: "timlach". i "timlach" – yachol beme melach? talmud lomar: "bammelach".

"Velo tashbit melach" – have melach sheenah shovetet, veezo zo? melach sedomit. uminnayin sheim lo matza melach sedomit shemmevi melach isterokanit? talmud lomar "takriv" – "takriv" kol shehu, "takriv" mikkol makom, "takriv" vaafillu beshabbat, "takriv" vaafillu betumea.

May "tevonehu"? amar rabba bar ulla: hachi kaamar, yachol yitbonennu keteven betit. amar leh abbaye: i hachi, "yitbonennu" mibbee leh! ella amar abbaye: yachol yaasennu kevinyan. amar leh rava: i hachi, "yivnennu" mibbee leh! ella amar rava: yachol tevunehu.
May "tevunehu"? amar rav ashe: yachol yitten bo taam kevina? talmud lomar: "timlach". ketzad hu ose? mevi haever venoten alav melach, vechozer vehofcho venoten alav melach, umaalehu.
Amar abbaye: vechen likdera.
b: Tanu rabbanan: melach sheal gabbe haever – moalin bo, sheal gabbe hakkevesh veshebberosho shel mizbeach – en moalin bo. (veamar) [amar] rav matna: may keraa? "vehikravtam lifne Adonai vehishlichu hakkohanim alehem melach veheelu otam ola laAdonai".
Tenan hatam: al hammelach veal haetzim, sheyyehu hakkohanim neotin bahen. amar shemuel: lo shanu ella lekorbanam, aval laachila – la.
Ka salka datin, may lekorbanam – limloach korbanam. leechol – achilat kadashim. hasheta limloach orot kadashim yahavinan, laachilat kodashim la yahavinan?

Detanya: nimtzeta atta omer, bishlosha mekomot hammelach netuna: belishkat hammelach, veal gabbe hakkevesh, uverosho shel mizbeach. belishkat hammelach – sheshsham molchin orot kadashim, al gabbe hakkevesh – sheshsham molchim et haevarim, berosho shel mizbeach – sheshsham molchin hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim, veolat haof.
Ella may lekorbanam – laachilat korbanam, umay laachila – achila dechullin.
Chullin, peshita! may bau hatam? af al gav deamar mar "yochlu", sheyyochlu immah chullin uteruma kede shettehe neechelet al hassova, afillu hachi melach dekadashim la yahavinan lehu.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach may lekorbanam – limloach, tama deatni bet din, ha la atni bet din – la? hasheta leyisrael yahavinan, lechohanim la yahavinan?

Detanya: yachol haomer "hare alay mincha" – yavi melach mittoch beto, kederech shemmevi levona mittoch beto? vedin hu: neemar have mincha vehave melach, veneemar have mincha vehave levona, ma levona mittoch beto – af melach mittoch beto.
O kelach lederech zo: neemar have mincha vehave melach, veneemar have mincha vehave etzim – ma etzim mishshel tzibbur, af melach mishshel tzibbur!
Nire lemi dome, danin davar hannoheg bechol hazzevachim middavar hannoheg bechol hazzevachim, veal tochiach levona sheenah noheget bechol hazzevachim.
O kelach lederech zo: danin davar habba immah bichli echad, middavar habba immah bichli echad, veal yochichu etzim sheenan bain immah bichli echad!
Talmud lomar: "berit melach olam hiv", ulehallan hu omer: "meet bene yisrael berit olam", ma lehallan mishshel tzibbur, af kan mishshel tzibbur.
Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: hachi kaamar rav shisha bereh derav idi: lo nitzrecha ella leven bucheri.

Ditnan: amar rabbi yehuda, heid ben bucheri beyavne: kol kohen sheshshokel eno chote. amar lo rabban yochanan ben zakkay: lo chi, ella kol kohen sheeno shokel chote, ella shehakkohanim dorshin mikra ze leatzman:
